recipes.name: Lychee, lime and ginger granita
recipes.method_note: Icy and refreshing after a feast.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:water}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}} 5 minutes. Cool.
Blend {{ing:lychees}} with the syrup and the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Strain.
Pour into a shallow tray. Freeze 1 hour.
Scrape with a fork. Freeze again. Repeat every 30 minutes, 3 times.
Spoon into chilled glasses.

swaps.text: Mango or pineapple

recipes.name: Luxury black forest trifle
recipes.method_note: Chocolate sponge, kirsch cherries, rich custard and cream.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:cherries}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} 5 minutes. Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (kirsch). Cool.
Cube {{ing:brioche}}. Layer in a glass bowl. Spoon over the cherry juice.
Add the cherries.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir into {{ing:custard-ready}}. Pour over.
Chill 1 hour.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Spread on top.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

swaps.text: Cherry juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Vegan espresso and chocolate silk tart
recipes.method_note: A no-bake tart that tastes like a mocha. Nobody will guess.

steps.instruction: Blitz {{ing:oats-rolled}}, {{ing:dates-pitted}}, {{ing:almonds}} and 1 tbsp of {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.
Press into a 22 cm tin. Chill.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Dissolve {{ing:coffee-instant}} in 1 tbsp hot water.
Blend {{ing:tofu-silken}}, the chocolate, coffee and {{ing:maple-syrup}} until silky.
Pour into the case. Chill 4 hours, until set.
Dust with the rest of the cocoa.

swaps.text: Oats labelled gluten free, for a gluten-free tart

recipes.name: Honey-poached quince with vanilla and crème fraîche
recipes.method_note: Slow poaching turns pale quince a deep, glowing pink.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C. Peel, quarter and core {{ing:quince}}.
Lay in a dish with {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Add the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and water to cover.
Cover with foil. Bake 3 hours, until soft and pink.
Serve warm with {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, with coconut yoghurt, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Salted caramel and hazelnut brownies
recipes.method_note: Fudgy, gooey and deeply chocolatey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 x 30 cm tin.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} until thick. Fold in the chocolate.
Sift in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:cocoa-powder}}. Fold. Add toasted {{ing:hazelnuts}}.
Spread in the tin. Dot with {{ing:dulce-de-leche}}. Swirl. Sprinkle {{ing:salt}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until barely set in the middle.
steps.note: They firm up as they cool.

steps.instruction: Cool in the tin. Cut into 12.

swaps.text: Ground almonds, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Espresso martini tiramisu
recipes.method_note: The cocktail as a pudding: coffee, vodka and coffee liqueur.

steps.instruction: Dissolve {{ing:coffee-instant}} in 300 ml boiling water. Cool. Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka) and {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (coffee liqueur).
Whisk {{ing:mascarpone}}, {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}} until thick.
Dip half of {{ing:sponge-fingers}} briefly in the coffee. Lay in a dish.
Spread with half the cream. Repeat.
Chill 6 hours.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

swaps.text: More coffee, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Spiced plum and almond galette
recipes.method_note: A rustic open tart. Rough edges are the charm.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Roll {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}} into a 30 cm circle on a lined tray.
Mix {{ing:ground-almonds}} with half the sugar. Spread over the middle.
Halve and stone {{ing:plums}}. Pile on top, leaving a 5 cm edge.
Dust with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and ground {{ing:star-anise}}.
Fold the edge over the fruit. Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Sprinkle the rest of {{ing:sugar-demerara}}.
Bake 40 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
Serve warm with {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free shortcrust, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Mango sticky rice with coconut and lime
recipes.method_note: The Thai street classic. Salty-sweet coconut sauce is the magic.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}} until soft and sticky.
Warm {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:salt}} until dissolved.
Stir two thirds into the hot rice. Cover. Leave 20 minutes.
Slice {{ing:mango}}.
Spoon the rice onto plates. Add the mango. Pour over the rest of the coconut.
Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}}. Add lime zest.

swaps.text: Glutinous (sticky) rice, soaked overnight, for the traditional version

recipes.name: Cherry and almond clafoutis
recipes.method_note: A French batter pudding, puffed and golden.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Butter a dish with {{ing:butter-block}}. Scatter in {{ing:cherries}}.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Whisk in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:ground-almonds}}.
Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (amaretto) until smooth.
Pour over the cherries.
Bake 35 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Serve warm.

swaps.text: A drop of almond extract, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Prosecco and raspberry jellies
recipes.method_note: Set softly with cornflour, so they are vegan. Soft, glistening and boozy.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:cranberry-juice}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Whisk in {{ing:cornflour}} mixed with 4 tbsp cold water. Stir 3 minutes, until thick and clear.
Cool 10 minutes. Stir in {{ing:sparkling-wine}} gently.
Divide {{ing:raspberries}} between 6 glasses. Pour over.
Chill 4 hours, until set.
Top with {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

swaps.text: Sparkling grape juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Saffron, honey and pistachio ice cream (no churn)
recipes.method_note: Inspired by Persian bastani. No machine needed.

steps.instruction: Steep {{ing:saffron}} in 1 tbsp hot water 10 minutes.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks.
Fold in {{ing:condensed-milk}}, the saffron, {{ing:rose-water}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Fold in chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.
Freeze in a tub 6 hours, until firm.
Soften 10 minutes before scooping.

swaps.text: Leave them out, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Persimmon, pomegranate and mint salad with orange blossom
recipes.method_note: Light and jewel-bright.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:persimmon}} into thin wedges.
Arrange on a plate with segments of {{ing:orange}}.
Mix {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:rose-water}} (orange blossom water). Drizzle over.
Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

swaps.text: Mango or ripe pear

recipes.name: Chocolate fondue with fruit and brioche
recipes.method_note: Something to share by the fire.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:double-cream}} until steaming. Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Stir until glossy. Stir in {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Keep warm over a candle or a pan of hot water.
Cut {{ing:strawberries}}, {{ing:clementine}}, {{ing:banana-medium}} and toasted {{ing:brioche}} into bite-sized pieces.
Serve with forks for dipping.

swaps.text: Coconut cream, with vegan chocolate, for a vegan fondue

recipes.name: Panettone and marsala semifreddo
recipes.method_note: A frozen Italian cream with chunks of panettone. Make up to a week ahead.

steps.instruction: Line a 900 g loaf tin with cling film.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:sherry}} (Marsala) over simmering water 8 minutes, until thick.
steps.note: It should reach 71C, so the eggs are cooked.

steps.instruction: Whisk off the heat until cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks. Fold in.
Fold in cubes of {{ing:panettone}}, chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} and {{ing:pistachios}}.
Pour into the tin. Freeze overnight.
Turn out. Slice with a hot knife.

swaps.text: Orange juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Pink grapefruit and rosemary sorbet
recipes.method_note: A palate cleanser between courses, or a light finish.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:water}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} 5 minutes. Cool. Remove the rosemary.
Squeeze {{ing:grapefruit}} and {{ing:lemon}}. Mix with the syrup.
Freeze in a tray, scraping and stirring every hour, 4 times.
Blend briefly before serving for a smooth texture.

swaps.text: Blood oranges

recipes.name: Profiteroles with praline cream and hot chocolate sauce
recipes.method_note: Choux pastry is easier than it looks. Dry them well so they stay crisp.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Bring {{ing:butter-block}} and 200 ml water to the boil.
Tip in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Beat until it leaves the pan. Cool 5 minutes.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}} one at a time, until glossy.
Pipe 24 small balls. Bake 25 minutes, until crisp. Pierce each.
Caramelise {{ing:sugar-caster}} with {{ing:hazelnuts}}. Cool. Blitz to crumbs.
steps.note: Molten sugar is very hot.

steps.instruction: Whip 300 ml of {{ing:double-cream}}. Fold in the praline. Pipe into the buns.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} with the rest of the cream. Pour over to serve.

swaps.text: Plain whipped cream with vanilla

recipes.name: Truffle and Parmesan mash
recipes.method_note: Rich enough for the main event.

steps.instruction: Peel and chunk {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain. Steam dry 2 minutes. Push through a ricer or mash.
Beat in {{ing:butter-block}}, warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:parmesan}}.
Season. Drizzle {{ing:truffle-oil}} to serve.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Duck fat roast potatoes with garlic and rosemary
recipes.method_note: The crispest roast potatoes there are.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Melt {{ing:duck-fat}} in a roasting tin in the oven.
Peel and chunk {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 8 minutes. Drain. Shake to rough up.
Tip into the hot fat. Roast 30 minutes.
Turn. Add {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Roast 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with {{ing:salt}}.

swaps.text: Vegetable oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Pommes Anna
recipes.method_note: A golden cake of thin potato slices and butter.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Slice 2 mm thin. Do not rinse.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Brush a 22 cm ovenproof pan.
Layer the slices in overlapping circles, brushing with butter and adding thyme and salt.
Press down. Cook on the hob 5 minutes.
Bake 45 minutes, until tender and golden underneath.
Turn out onto a board. Cut into wedges.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Shredded sprouts with brown butter, hazelnuts and lemon
recipes.method_note: Fast, bright and nutty.

steps.instruction: Shred {{ing:brussels-sprouts}} finely.
Brown {{ing:butter-block}} with chopped {{ing:hazelnuts}} until nutty.
Add the sprouts. Toss 4 minutes, until bright and tender-crisp.
Add lemon zest and juice. Season. Grate over {{ing:parmesan}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil and no cheese, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Honey-roast heritage beetroot and carrots with dukkah
recipes.method_note: Colourful and crunchy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:beetroot-raw}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} into wedges.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast 35 minutes.
Drizzle {{ing:honey}}. Roast 10 minutes more.
Toast and crush {{ing:hazelnuts}}, {{ing:sesame-seeds}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}} and {{ing:coriander-ground}}.
Scatter the dukkah over the vegetables.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Celeriac and potato gratin with Gruyère
recipes.method_note: Creamy, cheesy and earthy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C.
Peel and thinly slice {{ing:celeriac}} and {{ing:potato-large}}.
Warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} with {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Layer the slices in a dish, seasoning. Pour over the cream.
Top with grated {{ing:gruyere}}. Bake 1 hour 20 minutes.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian alpine-style cheese

recipes.name: Glazed chestnuts and shallots with thyme
recipes.method_note: A sweet, glossy side for turkey or nut roast.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:shallot}}. Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} 10 minutes, until golden.
Add {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}}, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Cook 5 minutes, tossing, until glazed.

recipes.name: Red cabbage with port, orange and juniper
recipes.method_note: A richer, spicier red cabbage.

steps.instruction: Fry sliced {{ing:red-onion}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 5 minutes.
Add shredded {{ing:red-cabbage}}, {{ing:port}}, the zest and juice of {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Add crushed {{ing:juniper-berries}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.
Cover. Cook on a low heat 1 hour.

swaps.text: Red grape juice, for no alcohol (check port is labelled vegan)

recipes.name: Silky parsnip and vanilla purée
recipes.method_note: A touch of vanilla brings out parsnip's sweetness. Lovely with game.

steps.instruction: Peel and chop {{ing:parsnip}}.
Simmer in {{ing:milk-whole}} 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain, keeping the milk. Blend with {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Add milk until silky. Season.

swaps.text: Oat milk and olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Wild rice, chestnut and cranberry pilaf
recipes.method_note: A festive rice side, or a stuffing for vegans.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:wild-rice}} 40 minutes. Add {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} for the last 12 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes.
Drain the rice. Mix with onion, crumbled {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} and {{ing:dried-cranberries}}.
Add {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and orange zest. Season.

recipes.name: Classic Champagne cocktail
recipes.method_note: A sugar cube, bitters, brandy and fizz: the 1920s glamour drink.

steps.instruction: Put a teaspoon of {{ing:sugar-demerara}} (or a sugar cube) in each flute.
Add a few drops of bitters, if you have them.
Add 15 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (cognac) to each.
Top up slowly with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.
Twist a strip of {{ing:orange}} peel over each.

swaps.text: Sparkling grape juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Pomegranate and orange winter spritz
recipes.method_note: Bittersweet, ruby red and festive.

steps.instruction: Fill four wine glasses with ice.
Add 50 ml of {{ing:pomegranate-juice}} and 15 ml of {{ing:orange-liqueur}} to each.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.
Add a slice of {{ing:orange}} and a few {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Use soda water and no liqueur

recipes.name: Gingerbread white Russian
recipes.method_note: Creamy, spiced and very festive.

steps.instruction: Fill two tumblers with ice.
Add 30 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka) and 20 ml of {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (coffee liqueur) to each.
Whisk {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:golden-syrup}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}. Float on top.
Crumble over {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}}.

swaps.text: Cold coffee instead of vodka and liqueur

recipes.name: Hot buttered rum
recipes.method_note: A warming fireside drink.

steps.instruction: Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Divide between two mugs with {{ing:cloves}}.
Add 50 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (dark rum) to each.
Top up with 150 ml hot water. Stir until melted.

swaps.text: Hot apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Yuzu and sake highball
recipes.method_note: Light, citrussy and Japanese: perfect with the Asian menus.

steps.instruction: Stir {{ing:sugar-caster}} into {{ing:yuzu-juice}} until dissolved.
Fill two tall glasses with ice. Add the yuzu.
Add 60 ml of {{ing:sake}} to each.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}. Add a slice of {{ing:lime}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a yuzu soda

recipes.name: Passion fruit fizz martini
recipes.method_note: Tropical and glamorous, with a shot of fizz on the side.

steps.instruction: Scoop out {{ing:passion-fruit}}, keeping two halves to float.
Shake the pulp, {{ing:spirit-40}} (vanilla vodka), lime juice and {{ing:sugar-caster}} with ice.
Strain into two chilled glasses. Float a passion fruit half on each.
Serve {{ing:sparkling-wine}} in a shot glass alongside.

swaps.text: Shake with apple juice and top with soda, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Cranberry and rosemary shrub (no alcohol)
recipes.method_note: A shrub is a fruit vinegar syrup: sharp, complex and grown-up.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:cranberries}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} with 100 ml water until burst.
Add {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} (cider vinegar is best). Cool. Strain.
Keep in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
Pour 40 ml per glass over ice. Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.

recipes.name: Spiced pear bellini
recipes.method_note: Softer than a peach bellini, warmly spiced.

steps.instruction: Simmer peeled, chopped {{ing:pear}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and 100 ml water 10 minutes.
Remove the spices. Blend until smooth. Chill.
Put 2 tbsp purée in each flute.
Top up slowly with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}, stirring once.

swaps.text: Sparkling elderflower, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Chai-spiced white hot chocolate
recipes.method_note: Cardamom, ginger and cinnamon in creamy white chocolate.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:milk-whole}} with crushed {{ing:cardamom}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}}, {{ing:black-peppercorns}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}.
Leave 10 minutes off the heat.
Strain. Warm again. Whisk in {{ing:white-chocolate}} until melted.
Pour into mugs.

swaps.text: Oat milk with vegan white chocolate, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Lychee, ginger and lime sparkler
recipes.method_note: Floral and fresh: a soft drink worth dressing up for.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:lychees}} with grated {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Strain.
Divide between four glasses of ice.
Top up with {{ing:ginger-ale}}. Add {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Mulled port with orange and star anise
recipes.method_note: Small glasses only: rich and strong.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:port}} and {{ing:grape-juice-red}} into a pan.
Add sliced {{ing:orange}}, {{ing:star-anise}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:cloves}}.
Warm 10 minutes without boiling.
Serve in small glasses.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Espresso tonic with orange
recipes.method_note: Bitter, bright and fizzy. A grown-up soft drink.

steps.instruction: Make two shots of espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}. Cool.
Fill two glasses with ice and {{ing:tonic-water}}.
Pour the espresso slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats.
Add a slice of {{ing:orange}}.

recipes.name: Maple and orange old fashioned
recipes.method_note: Stirred, not shaken: strong and smooth.

steps.instruction: Stir {{ing:spirit-40}} (bourbon or whisky) and {{ing:maple-syrup}} with ice for 30 seconds.
Add a few drops of bitters, if you have them.
Strain over a large ice cube in each glass.
Twist a strip of {{ing:orange}} peel over the top.

swaps.text: Cold black tea with maple and orange, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Mulled cranberry and pomegranate (no alcohol)
recipes.method_note: Deep red and spiced: the soft drink for the main course.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:cranberry-juice}} and {{ing:pomegranate-juice}} into a pan.
Add sliced {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and {{ing:star-anise}}.
Warm 15 minutes without boiling.
Ladle into mugs.

recipes.name: Salted caramel espresso martini
recipes.method_note: The festive twist on the modern classic.

steps.instruction: Make 60 ml espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}. Stir in {{ing:dulce-de-leche}} and {{ing:salt}}. Cool.
Shake with {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka), {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (coffee liqueur) and ice for 20 seconds.
Strain into two chilled glasses.

swaps.text: Shake the caramel coffee with oat milk and ice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Chateaubriand for two with red wine jus
recipes.method_note: The thick centre of the fillet, carved at the table.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Season {{ing:beef-fillet}} well.
Sear in {{ing:olive-oil}} 6 minutes, turning, until browned all over.
Add {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Baste 1 minute.
Roast 15 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} in the pan. Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Boil until halved.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} and the resting juices. Boil 4 minutes.
Carve thickly. Pour over the jus.

swaps.text: More stock and 1 tsp redcurrant jelly, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Kerala halibut curry with coconut and curry leaves
recipes.method_note: Fragrant, tangy and golden: a South Indian Christmas.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}}. Add {{ing:mustard-seeds}}. When they pop, add {{ing:curry-leaves}}.
Fry sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} 8 minutes, until golden.
Add grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:tamarind-pulp}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}.
Add chunks of {{ing:halibut}}. Poach 5 minutes, until flaking.
Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Cod, hake or king prawns

recipes.name: Korean-style braised short ribs with kimchi rice
recipes.method_note: Sweet, savoury and sticky. Pear tenderises the meat, the Korean way.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:pear}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:gochujang}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Coat {{ing:beef-braising}} (short ribs). Marinate overnight.
Put in a casserole with 300 ml water. Cover. Braise at 150C 3 hours.
Uncover. Boil the sauce on the hob until sticky. Stir in {{ing:sesame-oil}}.
Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}. Stir through chopped {{ing:kimchi}}.
Serve with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Tamari and a gochujang labelled gluten free, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Cantonese ginger and spring onion lobster
recipes.method_note: A banquet dish from Hong Kong: fast, fragrant and glossy.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:lobster-tail}} through the shell into chunks. Dust with {{ing:cornflour}}.
Fry in hot {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 3 minutes, until red. Lift out.
Fry sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and white parts of {{ing:spring-onion}} 1 minute.
Add {{ing:sake}} (Shaoxing wine), {{ing:oyster-sauce}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}.
Return the lobster. Toss 2 minutes, until glossy. Add the green onion.
Serve over cooked {{ing:egg-noodles-dry}}.

swaps.text: Large shell-on king prawns

recipes.name: Tandoori-spiced whole side of salmon with mint raita
recipes.method_note: Smoky, spiced and vivid: a festive centrepiece with Indian flavours.

steps.instruction: Mix 100 g of {{ing:natural-yoghurt}} with {{ing:garam-masala}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:turmeric-ground}}.
Add grated {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and the juice of half of {{ing:lemon}}.
Spread over {{ing:salmon-fillet}}. Marinate 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 220C. Roast 18 minutes, until charred at the edges.
Grate {{ing:cucumber}}. Squeeze out the water.
Mix with the rest of the yoghurt and chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}} for the raita.
Serve with lemon wedges and the raita.

swaps.text: Coconut yoghurt, for a dairy-free version

recipes.name: Persian jewelled rice with saffron and pistachios
recipes.method_note: Golden crust (tahdig) on the bottom, jewels of fruit and nuts on top.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} in salted water 1 hour. Drain.
Steep {{ing:saffron}} in 3 tbsp hot water.
Boil the rice with crushed {{ing:cardamom}} 6 minutes. Drain.
Melt half of {{ing:butter-block}} in a heavy pan. Pack in a layer of rice mixed with saffron.
Pile in the rest of the rice. Make holes with a spoon handle. Dot with butter.
Cover with a tea towel and lid. Cook on a low heat 40 minutes.
steps.note: The towel stops drips making the crust soggy.

steps.instruction: Simmer orange peel strips, chopped {{ing:dried-apricots}} and {{ing:dried-cranberries}} in water with {{ing:sugar-caster}} 5 minutes.
Turn out. Scatter the fruit, {{ing:pistachios}} and toasted {{ing:almonds}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Truffle cacio e pepe
recipes.method_note: Three ingredients and technique: cheese, pepper and pasta water make the sauce.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} in less water than usual, so it is starchy.
Toast crushed {{ing:black-peppercorns}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 1 minute.
Add a ladle of pasta water. Add the drained pasta.
Off the heat, add finely grated {{ing:parmesan}} a handful at a time, tossing.
steps.note: Off the heat, or the cheese clumps.

steps.instruction: Add pasta water until creamy. Finish with {{ing:truffle-oil}}.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese (traditionally Pecorino)

recipes.name: Earl Grey and lemon posset with shortbread
recipes.method_note: Bergamot tea perfumes the cream.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:tea-bags}} (Earl Grey). Leave 10 minutes. Squeeze and remove.
Add {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Bring to the boil. Bubble 3 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Pour into 6 glasses. Chill 4 hours, until set.
Serve with {{ing:shortbread}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free biscuits, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Yuzu and lime tart
recipes.method_note: Like a lemon tart, but floral and exotic.

steps.instruction: Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake blind at 190C 25 minutes.
Turn the oven to 150C.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Whisk in {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:yuzu-juice}} and lime juice and zest.
Skim off any froth. Pour into the case.
Bake 30 minutes, until set with a wobble.
Cool. Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.

swaps.text: All lime, or half lime, half grapefruit

recipes.name: Roast pears with white miso caramel and sesame
recipes.method_note: Sweet, salty and deeply savoury. A modern Japanese-inspired finish.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Halve and core {{ing:pear}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}} in an ovenproof pan. Add the pears cut side down.
Roast 20 minutes, until tender.
Lift out the pears. Whisk {{ing:miso-paste}} and {{ing:double-cream}} into the pan juices.
Bubble 2 minutes, until glossy.
Serve with {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}}, the caramel and toasted {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

swaps.text: A pinch of sea salt
Check the miso and ice cream labels

recipes.name: Chocolate, chilli and cinnamon pots (Mexican style)
recipes.method_note: A gentle warmth after the chocolate. Vegan and set in the fridge.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:coconut-cream}} with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}} until steaming.
Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir until glossy.
Stir in {{ing:maple-syrup}} and orange zest.
Pour into 6 small cups. Chill 3 hours.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Crispy oyster sliders with lemon mayonnaise
recipes.method_note: New Orleans style: crunchy fried oysters in soft rolls.

steps.instruction: Drain {{ing:oysters}}. Pat dry.
Dust in {{ing:flour-plain}} with {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}, then beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}, then {{ing:panko}}.
Deep-fry in 5 cm of vegetable oil at 180C for 90 seconds, until golden.
steps.note: Nutrition counts only the oil the food soaks up.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}} with the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Split {{ing:brioche}} (4 rolls). Fill with {{ing:cos-lettuce}}, oysters and mayonnaise.

swaps.text: Large raw king prawns

recipes.name: Clementine negroni
recipes.method_note: Bitter, sweet and strong, brightened with fresh clementine.

steps.instruction: Fill a jug with ice.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (gin), {{ing:vermouth}} (sweet, red) and {{ing:bitter-aperitivo}}.
Stir 30 seconds, until very cold.
Strain over fresh ice. Add a slice of {{ing:clementine}}.

recipes.name: Negroni sbagliato
recipes.method_note: The "mistaken" negroni: sparkling wine in place of gin. Lighter and festive.

steps.instruction: Fill two glasses with ice.
Pour in {{ing:vermouth}} and {{ing:bitter-aperitivo}}. Stir.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.
Add a slice of {{ing:orange}}.

recipes.name: Blood orange aperitivo spritz
recipes.method_note: Bittersweet, fizzy and bright. The classic Italian aperitif.

steps.instruction: Fill two wine glasses with ice.
Pour in {{ing:sparkling-wine}}, then {{ing:bitter-aperitivo}}.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.
Add a slice of {{ing:grapefruit}} or blood orange.

recipes.name: Mulled white wine with pear and ginger
recipes.method_note: Paler and more delicate than the red, with honeyed pear.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:wine-white}}, {{ing:apple-juice}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a pan.
Add sliced {{ing:pear}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and peel of {{ing:lemon}}.
Warm gently 15 minutes. Do not let it boil.
Ladle into heatproof glasses.

recipes.name: Hot buttered rum
recipes.method_note: A spiced, velvety nightcap.

steps.instruction: Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Divide between two mugs.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (dark rum).
Top with {{ing:water}}, freshly boiled. Stir until the butter melts.

recipes.name: Hot toddy with honey, lemon and clove
recipes.method_note: Warming and soothing on a cold night.

steps.instruction: Stud two slices of {{ing:lemon}} with {{ing:cloves}}.
Put in two mugs with {{ing:honey}}, half of {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} each and {{ing:spirit-40}} (whisky).
Top with {{ing:water}}, freshly boiled. Stir.
Add a squeeze of the rest of the lemon.

recipes.name: French 75
recipes.method_note: Gin, lemon and Champagne. Crisp and celebratory.

steps.instruction: Shake {{ing:spirit-40}} (gin), {{ing:lemon-juice}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} with ice.
Strain into two flutes.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.

recipes.name: Blackberry and thyme royale
recipes.method_note: A purple twist on the kir royale, made with fresh berries.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:blackberries}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and 50 ml water 5 minutes. Sieve. Cool.
Put 1 tbsp syrup in each flute.
Top slowly with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.

recipes.name: Pomegranate margarita
recipes.method_note: Tart, salty-rimmed and jewel red.

steps.instruction: Rub a lime wedge round two glass rims. Dip in {{ing:salt}}.
Shake {{ing:spirit-40}} (tequila), {{ing:orange-liqueur}}, {{ing:pomegranate-juice}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}} with ice.
Strain over fresh ice.

recipes.name: Espresso martini
recipes.method_note: Silky, frothy and a little bit wicked.

steps.instruction: Make two shots of espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}. Stir in {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Cool.
Shake hard with {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka), {{ing:orange-liqueur}} and lots of ice.
Strain into chilled glasses. A foam forms on top.

recipes.name: Cranberry cosmopolitan
recipes.method_note: Pink, sharp and very Christmassy.

steps.instruction: Shake {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka), {{ing:orange-liqueur}}, {{ing:cranberry-juice}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}} with ice.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Drop in a few {{ing:cranberries}}.

recipes.name: Chocolate orange martini
recipes.method_note: A pudding in a glass.

steps.instruction: Shake {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka), {{ing:orange-liqueur}}, {{ing:single-cream}} and {{ing:cocoa-powder}} with ice.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Grate over {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.

recipes.name: Clementine mimosa
recipes.method_note: For Christmas morning: fresh juice and fizz.

steps.instruction: Squeeze {{ing:clementine}}. Strain the juice.
Fill flutes a third full with juice.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.

recipes.name: Spiced pear bellini
recipes.method_note: Soft pear purée topped up with sparkling wine.

steps.instruction: Simmer peeled, chopped {{ing:pear}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and a splash of water 8 minutes.
Blend smooth with a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}. Chill.
Put 2 tbsp purée in each flute. Top with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.

recipes.name: Dark and stormy
recipes.method_note: Dark rum, fiery ginger beer and lime.

steps.instruction: Fill two tall glasses with ice.
Pour in {{ing:ginger-beer}}.
Float {{ing:spirit-40}} (dark rum) on top.
Add a wedge of {{ing:lime}}.

recipes.name: Maple whisky sour
recipes.method_note: Smooth and frothy. Shake once without ice, then with.

steps.instruction: Shake {{ing:spirit-40}} (whisky), {{ing:lemon-juice}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:egg-white}} without ice for 15 seconds.
Add ice. Shake hard again.
Strain into glasses over fresh ice.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a vegan version without the foam

recipes.name: Sherry cobbler
recipes.method_note: A Victorian favourite: sherry on crushed ice with fruit.

steps.instruction: Shake {{ing:sherry}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} with two slices of {{ing:orange}} and ice.
Strain over crushed ice.
Top with {{ing:raspberries}} and a slice of orange.

recipes.name: Vermouth and tonic with orange
recipes.method_note: Lower in alcohol and very refreshing.

steps.instruction: Fill two glasses with ice.
Add {{ing:vermouth}}. Top with {{ing:tonic-water}}.
Add a slice of {{ing:orange}}.

recipes.name: Boulevardier
recipes.method_note: A negroni made with whisky: warmer and rounder for winter.

steps.instruction: Stir {{ing:spirit-40}} (bourbon or rye), {{ing:vermouth}} and {{ing:bitter-aperitivo}} with ice.
Strain over a large ice cube.
Twist a strip of {{ing:orange}} peel over the glass.

recipes.name: Pink grapefruit and rosemary soda
recipes.method_note: Bitter-sweet and herbal: a grown-up soft drink.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and 80 ml water 3 minutes. Cool.
Squeeze {{ing:grapefruit}}.
Mix the juice and syrup. Pour over ice.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.

recipes.name: Spiced pear sparkler
recipes.method_note: Soft and festive, with a gentle fizz.

steps.instruction: Simmer chopped {{ing:pear}} in {{ing:apple-juice}} with {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} 10 minutes.
Blend. Sieve. Chill.
Fill glasses halfway. Top with {{ing:ginger-ale}}. Add a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Hot apple and cinnamon punch
recipes.method_note: A warm pot for carol singers and drivers.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:apple-juice}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in a pan.
Add a sliced {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:maple-syrup}}.
Warm gently 15 minutes.
Ladle into mugs.

recipes.name: Clementine and thyme sparkler
recipes.method_note: Fresh juice, a herbal note, lots of bubbles.

steps.instruction: Squeeze {{ing:clementine}}.
Bruise {{ing:fresh-thyme}} in a jug. Add the juice and ice.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-water}}. Add a squeeze of {{ing:lime}}.

recipes.name: Cranberry and lime virgin mojito
recipes.method_note: Muddled mint and lime, with tart cranberry.

steps.instruction: Muddle {{ing:fresh-mint}}, wedges of {{ing:lime}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a jug.
Add crushed ice and {{ing:cranberry-juice}}.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-water}}. Drop in {{ing:cranberries}}.

recipes.name: Pomegranate and mint cooler
recipes.method_note: Tart, ruby and refreshing.

steps.instruction: Bruise {{ing:fresh-mint}} in a jug.
Add {{ing:pomegranate-juice}}, the juice of {{ing:lime}} and ice.
Top with {{ing:sparkling-water}}. Add {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

recipes.name: Masala chai
recipes.method_note: Spiced, milky tea, simmered on the hob.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:water}} with crushed {{ing:cardamom}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:cloves}} 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:tea-bags}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}. Simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Strain into cups.

swaps.text: Oat milk, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Salted caramel hot chocolate
recipes.method_note: Rich, sweet and salty. Top with cream for a treat.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:milk-whole}} until steaming.
Whisk in chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate}}, {{ing:dulce-de-leche}} and {{ing:salt}} until smooth.
Pour into mugs. Whip {{ing:double-cream}} and spoon on top.

recipes.name: Fresh mint hot chocolate
recipes.method_note: Real mint leaves steeped in milk: cleaner and brighter than mint flavouring.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:milk-whole}} with {{ing:fresh-mint}}. Leave 10 minutes. Strain.
Reheat. Whisk in chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Pour into mugs.

swaps.text: Oat milk and dairy-free chocolate, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Turmeric and ginger oat latte
recipes.method_note: Golden, gently spiced and warming.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:oat-milk}} with {{ing:turmeric-ground}}, {{ing:ginger-ground}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.
Heat until steaming, whisking.
Sweeten with {{ing:maple-syrup}}.

recipes.name: Spiced virgin Mary
recipes.method_note: Savoury and peppery: Boxing Day brunch in a glass.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:passata}}, {{ing:lemon}} juice, {{ing:worcestershire-sauce}} and {{ing:horseradish-sauce}}.
Season with {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}, {{ing:cayenne-pepper}} and salt.
Pour over ice. Add a stick of {{ing:celery-stick}} to each.

swaps.text: Most contain anchovy; use soy sauce for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Cardamom mango lassi
recipes.method_note: Creamy and cooling, good with spiced food.

steps.instruction: Blend the flesh of {{ing:mango}} with {{ing:natural-yoghurt}}, {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Add ground seeds from {{ing:cardamom}}. Blend again.
Pour over ice.

recipes.name: Lychee and lime iced tea
recipes.method_note: Fragrant, floral and light.

steps.instruction: Brew {{ing:tea-bags}} in 800 ml boiling water 4 minutes. Remove.
Stir in {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Cool.
Add peeled {{ing:lychees}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Serve over ice.

recipes.name: Fresh ginger, lemon and honey tea
recipes.method_note: A soothing, warming cup after a long day.

steps.instruction: Simmer sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in {{ing:water}} 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:honey}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Strain into mugs.

recipes.name: Elderflower and cucumber cooler
recipes.method_note: Cool and floral. Lovely with fish.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:cucumber}} into ribbons with a peeler.
Put in a jug with {{ing:elderflower-cordial}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Add ice. Top with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.

recipes.name: Pineapple and ginger punch
recipes.method_note: Sunny and spicy, for a party bowl.

steps.instruction: Blend half of {{ing:pineapple}} with {{ing:orange-juice}}. Sieve.
Dice the rest of the pineapple.
Mix in a bowl with the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Add ice and {{ing:ginger-beer}}. Scatter {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Virgin piña colada
recipes.method_note: Creamy coconut and pineapple, blended with ice.

steps.instruction: Peel and chop {{ing:pineapple}}, keeping back two wedges.
Blend with {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, the juice of {{ing:lime}} and a handful of ice.
Pour into glasses. Add a pineapple wedge to each.

recipes.name: Jewelled side of salmon with pomegranate and herbs
recipes.method_note: A glittering centrepiece: pink salmon under a confetti of herbs, nuts and pomegranate.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} skin-side down on a lined tray.
Rub with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:sumac}} and salt.
Bake 20 minutes, until opaque.
steps.note: 50C in the thickest part.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:fresh-dill}}, {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.
Mix with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}}, the rest of the oil and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Slide the salmon onto a platter. Pile the topping along it.

recipes.name: Citrus-baked salmon with beetroot new potatoes
recipes.method_note: Bold colours and fresh flavours: a light main for the days between.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:potato-medium}}, halved, 15 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} on slices of {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:lime}}.
Drizzle with half of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Bake 15 minutes.
Dice {{ing:beetroot}}. Toss with the warm potatoes, the rest of the oil and its pink juice.
Spoon over {{ing:soured-cream}} and {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Serve with the salmon and roast citrus.

recipes.name: Sea bass with sizzling ginger and spring onion
recipes.method_note: A Cantonese finish: hot oil poured over ginger and onion at the table.

steps.instruction: Steam {{ing:sea-bass-fillet}} over simmering water for 6 minutes.
Steam halved {{ing:pak-choi}} alongside for 4 minutes.
Lay on a warm plate. Pour over {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:sesame-oil}}.
Pile shredded {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:spring-onion}} on the fish.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} until smoking. Pour over to sizzle.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

swaps.text: Tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Whole roast sea bream with preserved lemon and fennel
recipes.method_note: A whole fish for the table. Salty lemon and aniseed fennel.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Slice {{ing:fennel-bulb}} thinly into a tin.
Toss with half of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast 15 minutes.
Chop the rind of {{ing:preserved-lemon}} with {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Slash {{ing:sea-bream}} three times each side. Stuff the slashes and cavity with the mixture.
Lay on the fennel. Pour over {{ing:wine-white}} and the rest of the oil.
Roast 25 minutes, until the flesh flakes from the bone.

recipes.name: Hake with chorizo, butter beans and saffron
recipes.method_note: Spanish flavours in one pan. Smoky, golden and comforting.

steps.instruction: Fry diced {{ing:chorizo}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 3 minutes.
Add chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Soften 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:saffron}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and drained {{ing:butter-beans-tinned}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Nestle in {{ing:hake-fillet}}. Cover. Cook 8 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

recipes.name: Herb-crusted cod with lentils and salsa verde
recipes.method_note: Crisp crumbs, flaky cod, earthy lentils.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:lentils-green-dry}} in {{ing:stock-vegetable}} for 25 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Mix {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:parmesan}}, half of {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, lemon zest and 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Press onto {{ing:cod-fillet}}. Bake 14 minutes.
Blend the rest of the parsley, oil, {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:lemon}} juice.
Serve the cod on the lentils with the green sauce.

recipes.name: Roast monkfish with romesco and charred leeks
recipes.method_note: Meaty monkfish with a smoky red pepper and almond sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Roast {{ing:pepper-bell}} 25 minutes, until blackened. Peel and seed.
Blend with toasted {{ing:almonds}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}}, {{ing:sherry}} and 3 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Rub {{ing:monkfish}} with 1 tbsp oil. Sear 3 minutes. Roast 10 minutes.
Halve {{ing:leek}}. Char in the rest of the oil for 6 minutes.
Serve the fish on the romesco with the leeks and {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Hot-smoked salmon kedgeree
recipes.method_note: A buttery, gently spiced rice for a late Boxing Day brunch.

steps.instruction: Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:curry-powder}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}} and {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}. Stir to coat.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Cover. Cook 12 minutes on a low heat.
Boil {{ing:egg-medium}} for 7 minutes. Peel and quarter.
Flake in {{ing:smoked-salmon}}. Fold through gently.
Top with the eggs, {{ing:fresh-coriander}} and {{ing:lemon}} wedges.

recipes.name: Portuguese seafood cataplana
recipes.method_note: A one-pot seafood stew, opened at the table in a cloud of steam.

steps.instruction: Soften sliced {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:smoked-paprika}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:wine-white}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add chunks of {{ing:hake-fillet}}, {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and rinsed {{ing:clams}}.
Cover tightly. Cook 6 minutes, until the clams open.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Throw away any shut clams.

recipes.name: Trout amandine with brown butter
recipes.method_note: A French classic, ready in ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:green-beans}} for 4 minutes. Drain.
Dust {{ing:trout-fillet}} in seasoned {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Fry skin side down in half of {{ing:butter-block}}, 3 minutes. Turn, 1 minute.
Lift out. Add the rest of the butter and sliced {{ing:almonds}}. Cook 2 minutes, until brown.
Add the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Spoon over the fish and beans.

swaps.text: Cornflour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Seared tuna with salsa verde and cannellini
recipes.method_note: Rare tuna, sharp herbs and creamy beans.

steps.instruction: Warm drained {{ing:cannellini-beans-tinned}} with 2 tbsp {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} for 5 minutes.
Blend {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:capers}}, {{ing:lemon}} juice and 2 tbsp oil.
Rub {{ing:tuna-steak}} with the rest of the oil and salt.
Sear in a very hot pan 90 seconds a side.
Slice. Serve on the beans with the green sauce.

recipes.name: Sticky teriyaki salmon with sesame greens
recipes.method_note: Glossy, sweet-salty salmon. Quick enough for a busy Christmas week.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}} as the pack says.
Simmer {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:mirin}}, {{ing:honey}} and grated {{ing:ginger-fresh}} until syrupy.
Heat the oven to 200C. Brush {{ing:salmon-fillet}} with the glaze.
Bake 12 minutes, brushing once more.
Steam {{ing:broccoli-head}} florets 4 minutes. Toss with {{ing:sesame-oil}}.
Scatter everything with {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

recipes.name: Baked sea bream with tomatoes, olives and oregano
recipes.method_note: A Greek island way with fish: baked in a sweet tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Soften sliced {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in half of {{ing:olive-oil}} for 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:olives-pitted}}, {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:dried-oregano}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Pour into a dish. Lay {{ing:sea-bream}} on top. Drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Bake 25 minutes.
Serve with {{ing:lemon}} wedges.

recipes.name: Smoked haddock and sweetcorn chowder
recipes.method_note: Creamy, smoky and filling. A pot of comfort for a cold evening.

steps.instruction: Fry chopped {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}} and {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 6 minutes.
Add diced {{ing:potato-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 15 minutes, until the potatoes are soft.
Add {{ing:haddock-smoked}} in chunks and {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}}. Scatter with {{ing:chives}}.

recipes.name: Goan cod curry with tamarind and coconut
recipes.method_note: Tangy, warming and bright red. Serve with rice.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} as the pack says.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} with {{ing:curry-leaves}} for 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:chilli-powder}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:tamarind-pulp}}. Simmer 8 minutes.
Add chunks of {{ing:cod-fillet}}. Simmer 6 minutes, until it flakes.

recipes.name: Salmon en papillote with citrus and fennel
recipes.method_note: Steamed in paper parcels, opened at the table.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut four large squares of baking paper.
Shave {{ing:fennel-bulb}}. Divide between the papers.
Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} on top with slices of {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:lemon}}.
Add {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:wine-white}} and {{ing:fresh-dill}}. Fold the paper into sealed parcels.
Bake 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Roast trout with beetroot, horseradish and watercress
recipes.method_note: Pink fish, ruby beetroot and a hot creamy sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:beetroot-raw}} into wedges.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast 40 minutes.
Lay {{ing:trout-fillet}} on top. Roast 10 minutes.
Mix {{ing:creme-fraiche}} with {{ing:horseradish-sauce}} and lemon juice.
Serve with {{ing:watercress}} and the sauce.

recipes.name: Basque hake in green sauce with clams
recipes.method_note: A parsley and garlic sauce that thickens in the pan as you shake it.

steps.instruction: Warm sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 2 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:wine-white}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Lay in {{ing:hake-fillet}} skin side up. Add rinsed {{ing:clams}}.
Cover. Cook 6 minutes, shaking the pan, until the clams open.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Throw away any shut clams.

recipes.name: Lobster mac and cheese
recipes.method_note: Comfort food at its most extravagant.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:lobster-tail}} 5 minutes. Cool, shell and chop.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes short of the pack time. Drain.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} until thick.
Stir in {{ing:gruyere}}, most of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}, {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}.
Fold in the pasta and lobster. Tip into a dish. Top with {{ing:panko}} and the rest of the cheese.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes, until bubbling.

recipes.name: Lobster spaghetti with tomato, chilli and basil
recipes.method_note: A romantic supper for two. Sweet lobster in a rich tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Halve {{ing:lobster-tail}} lengthways in the shell.
Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} as the pack says.
Fry {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 1 minute.
Add halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}} and {{ing:wine-white}}. Simmer 6 minutes.
Add the lobster, flesh side down. Cover. Cook 4 minutes.
Toss in the pasta, {{ing:fresh-basil}} and lemon zest.

recipes.name: King prawn laksa
recipes.method_note: Hot, sour, creamy and very fragrant.

steps.instruction: Fry {{ing:thai-red-curry-paste}} and {{ing:lemongrass}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Simmer 3 minutes, until pink.
Season with {{ing:fish-sauce}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Soak {{ing:rice-noodles-dry}} in boiling water 5 minutes.
Serve the soup over the noodles with {{ing:beansprouts}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Scallops with cauliflower purée, capers and golden raisins
recipes.method_note: A restaurant classic: sweet, salty, creamy.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:cauliflower-head}} florets in {{ing:milk-whole}} 15 minutes. Blend with half of {{ing:butter-block}}.
Soak {{ing:sultanas}} in lemon juice.
Pat {{ing:scallops}} dry. Sear in {{ing:olive-oil}} 90 seconds a side.
Add the rest of the butter, {{ing:capers}} and the sultanas. Sizzle 30 seconds.
Spoon purée onto plates. Top with scallops and the sauce. Scatter {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Zest over the {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Spaghetti alle vongole
recipes.method_note: The Italian Christmas Eve favourite. Clams, garlic, wine and parsley.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} 1 minute short of the pack time.
Warm sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 2 minutes.
Add rinsed {{ing:clams}} and {{ing:wine-white}}. Cover. Steam 4 minutes, until open.
Add the pasta and a splash of its water. Toss 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and lemon zest from {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Moules marinière with oven frites
recipes.method_note: Belgian bistro supper. Bake the chips while the mussels steam.

steps.instruction: Bake {{ing:oven-chips}} as the pack says.
Soften chopped {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 4 minutes.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Cover. Heat 4 minutes, shaking.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve with the chips.

recipes.name: Seafood paella
recipes.method_note: Do not stir once the stock is in: the crust on the bottom is the prize.

steps.instruction: Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a wide pan, 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:smoked-paprika}}, {{ing:saffron}}, {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}} and {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}.
Pour in {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Simmer 15 minutes without stirring.
Push in {{ing:squid}} rings, {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}, {{ing:mussels-cooked}} and {{ing:peas-frozen}}.
Cook 8 minutes more, until the rice is tender and crusty underneath.
Cover with foil. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Spanish paella rice, if you have it

recipes.name: Crab risotto with lemon and chilli
recipes.method_note: Creamy, sweet and bright. Add the crab at the end so it stays tender.

steps.instruction: Soften chopped {{ing:shallot}} in half of {{ing:butter-block}}, 4 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}. Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Stir until absorbed.
Add hot {{ing:stock-vegetable}} a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Stir in the rest of the butter, {{ing:parmesan}} and lemon zest.
Fold in {{ing:crab-white-meat}}, chopped {{ing:chilli-fresh}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Add a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: King prawn and tamarind curry
recipes.method_note: Sweet-sour and fiery, South Indian style.

steps.instruction: Sizzle {{ing:mustard-seeds}} and {{ing:curry-leaves}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Add chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Soften 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:chilli-powder}} and {{ing:turmeric-ground}}.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:tamarind-pulp}} and {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Simmer 4 minutes, until pink.

recipes.name: Grilled shellfish platter with garlic and herb butter
recipes.method_note: Langoustines, prawns and mussels under a hot grill, for eating with your hands.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to high.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, lemon zest and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.
Halve {{ing:langoustines}} lengthways. Lay on a tray with {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:mussels-cooked}}.
Dot everything with the butter.
Grill 5 minutes, until the prawns and langoustines turn pink.
Serve with {{ing:lemon}} wedges and torn {{ing:sourdough}} for the juices.

recipes.name: Gammon with an orange harissa glaze
recipes.method_note: Sweet citrus and warm chilli on a glossy ham. Lovely hot or cold on Boxing Day.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:gammon-joint}} in a big pan with {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:bay-leaf}}. Cover with cold water.
Simmer gently for 2 hours, topping up the water.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lift out the ham. Cut off the skin, leaving a layer of fat.
Score the fat in diamonds. Stud with {{ing:cloves}}.
Mix {{ing:harissa-paste}}, {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and the zest and juice of {{ing:orange}}.
Brush over the ham. Roast 30 minutes, basting twice, until sticky.

swaps.text: Wholegrain mustard, for a milder glaze

recipes.name: Za'atar and lemon turkey crown
recipes.method_note: Herby butter under the skin keeps the breast juicy and golden.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:turkey-crown}} out of the fridge 1 hour ahead. Heat the oven to 190C.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:zaatar}}, grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Loosen the skin. Push most of the butter underneath. Rub the rest on top.
Sit the crown on halved {{ing:onion-medium}} and the zested lemons in a tin. Pour in {{ing:wine-white}}.
Roast 90 minutes, basting twice, covering with foil if browning fast.
steps.note: 70C in the thickest part.

steps.instruction: Rest 30 minutes under foil before carving.

recipes.name: Turkey porchetta rolled with sausage, fennel and sage
recipes.method_note: A butterflied crown rolled round a herby stuffing. Easy carving, no bones.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Cut {{ing:turkey-crown}} off the bone in one piece, skin on.
Lay skin-side down. Bash the thick parts flat.
Mix {{ing:sausagemeat}}, crushed {{ing:fennel-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and lemon zest.
Spread over the turkey. Roll up tightly.
Wrap with {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}. Tie with string. Rub with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Roast 100 minutes, until golden.
steps.note: 72C in the middle of the stuffing.

steps.instruction: Rest 20 minutes. Slice into rounds.

swaps.text: Two boned turkey thighs, roasted 75 minutes

recipes.name: Roast turkey crown with sage and onion butter and gravy
recipes.method_note: A classic, done carefully: butter under the skin, a long rest, a proper gravy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Push the butter under the skin of {{ing:turkey-crown}}.
Sit the crown on chunks of {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} in a tin.
Roast 90 minutes, basting often.
steps.note: 70C in the thickest part.

steps.instruction: Lift onto a board. Rest 30 minutes under foil.
Stir {{ing:flour-plain}} into the tin juices on the hob.
Whisk in {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:port}}. Simmer 10 minutes. Sieve.

recipes.name: Roast topside with a horseradish and mustard crust
recipes.method_note: A budget roasting joint, cooked pink and sliced thin.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:beef-topside}} out of the fridge 1 hour ahead. Heat the oven to 220C.
Sear all over in {{ing:olive-oil}}, 6 minutes.
Mix {{ing:horseradish-sauce}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}. Spread over the top.
Press on {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} mixed with {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Sit on halved {{ing:onion-medium}}. Roast 15 minutes, then 160C for 40 minutes.
steps.note: 52C in the middle for pink.

steps.instruction: Rest 20 minutes. Deglaze the tin with {{ing:wine-red}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Bubble 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Beef bourguignon pie
recipes.method_note: The French stew under a puff pastry lid. Make the filling a day ahead.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Toss {{ing:beef-braising}} in {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Brown in batches in {{ing:olive-oil}}, 8 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}, {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} for 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}}, the beef, {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Cover. Cook in the oven for 2 hours 30 minutes. Cool.
Turn the oven to 200C. Tip into a pie dish. Top with {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Bake 35 minutes, until puffed.

recipes.name: Beef rendang
recipes.method_note: A dry, deeply spiced Indonesian curry. Slow cooking makes the beef tender.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:shallot}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:galangal}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}} to a paste.
Fry the paste in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} for 5 minutes, until fragrant.
Add {{ing:beef-braising}}, bruised {{ing:lemongrass}} and {{ing:lime-leaves}}.
Pour in {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Simmer, half covered, 2 hours.
Toast {{ing:desiccated-coconut}} in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until brown.
Stir in with {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and {{ing:tamarind-pulp}}. Cook 30 minutes, until dark and dry.

recipes.name: Beef fillet with salsa verde
recipes.method_note: Rosy beef with a sharp green sauce. Good hot or at room temperature.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Rub {{ing:beef-fillet}} with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt.
Sear all over in a hot pan, 5 minutes.
Roast 20 minutes for medium-rare.
steps.note: 50C in the middle.

steps.instruction: Rest 15 minutes.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:fresh-basil}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}}, {{ing:capers}}, {{ing:anchovy-fillet}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} finely.
Stir in {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and the rest of the oil.
Slice the beef. Spoon over the salsa verde.

recipes.name: Leg of lamb with anchovy, garlic and rosemary
recipes.method_note: The anchovies melt away, leaving deep savoury flavour, not fishiness.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Make 16 deep cuts in {{ing:lamb-leg}}.
Push half an {{ing:anchovy-fillet}}, a sliver of {{ing:garlic-clove}} and some {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} into each.
Rub with {{ing:olive-oil}} and pepper. Sit on sliced {{ing:onion-medium}}.
Roast 20 minutes. Pour in {{ing:wine-white}}. Turn to 180C.
Roast 60 minutes more for pink lamb.
steps.note: 58C in the middle.

steps.instruction: Rest 20 minutes. Carve and spoon over the pan juices.

recipes.name: Slow-roast spiced leg of lamb in yoghurt
recipes.method_note: A North Indian feast dish. Marinate overnight; it falls off the bone.

steps.instruction: Cut deep slashes all over {{ing:lamb-leg}}.
Blend {{ing:natural-yoghurt}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:garam-masala}}, {{ing:chilli-powder}} and {{ing:turmeric-ground}}.
Add {{ing:ground-almonds}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Rub into the lamb. Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 160C. Cover the tin with foil. Roast 4 hours.
Uncover. Turn to 200C. Roast 20 minutes, until charred.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}} and {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

recipes.name: Celebration rice with spiced lamb, chicken and garlic yoghurt
recipes.method_note: A big festive pilaf to set in the middle of the table and share.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}. Soak 20 minutes.
Brown {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} in 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}, 8 minutes. Set aside.
Fry sliced {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:lamb-mince}} in the rest of the oil for 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}, {{ing:allspice}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add the drained rice, the chicken, {{ing:saffron}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}.
Cover. Cook on a low heat 20 minutes. Rest 10 minutes.
Mix {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} with grated {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Turn out onto a platter. Top with toasted {{ing:almonds}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve with the yoghurt.

recipes.name: Saffron lamb shanks with sour cherries
recipes.method_note: Sweet-sour, fragrant and falling off the bone.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Brown {{ing:lamb-shank}} in {{ing:olive-oil}}, 10 minutes.
Soften sliced {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in the pan for 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:turmeric-ground}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:saffron}}.
Return the shanks. Add {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Cover. Bake 2 hours 30 minutes.
Add {{ing:sour-cherries-dried}} and {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}}. Bake 20 minutes uncovered.
Scatter with chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Lamb and pistachio meatballs with pomegranate and yoghurt
recipes.method_note: Spiced meatballs in a sweet-sour tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:lamb-mince}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and grated {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Add half of {{ing:fresh-mint}}, chopped. Roll into 20 balls.
Brown in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}}. Simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}, {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and the rest of the mint.

recipes.name: Slow pork belly with cider, fennel and apples
recipes.method_note: Crisp crackling on top, soft fennel and apples underneath.

steps.instruction: Score the skin of {{ing:pork-belly}}. Pat very dry.
Rub with crushed {{ing:fennel-seeds}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Heat the oven to 220C. Slice {{ing:fennel-bulb}}, {{ing:apple-medium}} and {{ing:onion-medium}} into a tin.
Sit the pork on top. Roast 30 minutes.
Pour {{ing:cider-dry}} round. Turn to 160C. Roast 2 hours.
Turn up to 230C for 15 minutes to crisp the crackling.
Rest 15 minutes. Cut into thick slices.

recipes.name: Pork saltimbocca with prosciutto, sage and Marsala
recipes.method_note: Quick and elegant. Thin pork, salty ham, crisp sage.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:pork-tenderloin}} into 8 slices. Bash each thin between cling film.
Lay a leaf of {{ing:fresh-sage}} on each. Wrap with a slice of {{ing:prosciutto}}.
Fry ham side down in {{ing:olive-oil}} and half the butter, 2 minutes. Turn, 2 minutes.
Lift out. Add {{ing:sherry}} to the pan. Bubble 1 minute.
Whisk in the rest of {{ing:butter-block}} and a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}. Pour over.

recipes.name: Sausage roll wreath with cranberry and sage
recipes.method_note: A sharing centrepiece for Christmas Eve or a buffet.

steps.instruction: Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 8 minutes. Cool.
Mix with {{ing:sausagemeat}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Heat the oven to 200C. Unroll {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Cut into 16 strips.
Put a sausage ball and a little {{ing:cranberry-sauce}} on each. Fold to make 16 rolls.
Arrange in a ring on a tray, touching. Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Roast gammon with pineapple and chilli glaze
recipes.method_note: Sticky, tropical and a little hot. Retro in the best way.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:gammon-joint}} in water for 1 hour 40 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Peel {{ing:pineapple}}. Blend half to a purée. Slice the rest.
Simmer the purée with {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}, {{ing:chilli-flakes}} and {{ing:allspice}} 8 minutes, until thick.
Stir in {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Remove the skin from the ham. Score the fat. Brush with glaze.
Roast with the pineapple slices 30 minutes, basting twice.

recipes.name: Slow duck legs with orange and Puy-style lentils
recipes.method_note: Crisp duck, earthy lentils. A bistro supper.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Prick the skin of {{ing:duck-leg}}. Rub with {{ing:salt}} and orange zest.
Roast 2 hours, until crisp. Pour off the fat as it gathers.
Soften diced {{ing:carrot-medium}}, {{ing:celery-stick}} and {{ing:shallot}} in 1 tbsp duck fat for 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:lentils-green-dry}}, {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the juice of {{ing:orange}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Serve the duck on the lentils.

recipes.name: Five-spice duck breast with roast plums
recipes.method_note: Pink duck with crisp skin, and plums roasted in star anise.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Score the skin of {{ing:duck-breast}}. Rub with {{ing:five-spice}} and salt.
Halve {{ing:plums}}. Toss with {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:star-anise}}.
Roast the plums 15 minutes.
Lay the duck skin down in a cold pan. Cook 8 minutes on a medium heat.
Turn. Roast in the oven 6 minutes. Rest 8 minutes.
Stir-fry halved {{ing:pak-choi}} with {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:sesame-oil}} for 3 minutes.
Slice the duck. Serve with the plums and their juice.

recipes.name: Pot-roast pheasant with cider, apple and cream
recipes.method_note: A Normandy-style game supper. Pot-roasting keeps the lean bird moist.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Brown {{ing:pheasant}} all over in {{ing:butter-block}}, 6 minutes.
Lay {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}} over the breasts.
Add halved {{ing:shallot}}, wedges of {{ing:apple-medium}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and {{ing:cider-dry}}.
Cover. Pot-roast 45 minutes.
Lift out the birds. Stir {{ing:creme-fraiche}} into the juices. Bubble 3 minutes.
Carve. Spoon over the sauce and apples.

recipes.name: Sumac roast quail with grapes and freekeh
recipes.method_note: Little birds, sticky grapes, smoky grains.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:freekeh}} in {{ing:stock-chicken}} for 20 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oven to 220C. Rub {{ing:quail}} with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:sumac}} and salt.
Put in a tin with {{ing:grapes}}. Drizzle the grapes with {{ing:honey}}.
Roast 20 minutes, until golden.
steps.note: Juices run clear at the thigh.

steps.instruction: Fold {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:lemon}} juice into the freekeh.
Serve the quail on the freekeh with the grapes.

recipes.name: Venison, juniper and red wine pie
recipes.method_note: Rich game under golden pastry. The filling freezes well.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Toss {{ing:venison-diced}} in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Brown in {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} for 8 minutes.
Add crushed {{ing:juniper-berries}}, {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}}.
Cover. Cook in the oven 2 hours. Cool.
Turn the oven to 200C. Fill a pie dish. Top with {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Bake 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Venison ragù with pappardelle-style ribbons
recipes.method_note: A slow Italian ragù made with game. Even better the next day.

steps.instruction: Brown {{ing:venison-diced}} and {{ing:pancetta}} in {{ing:olive-oil}}, 8 minutes.
Add chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}}, {{ing:celery-stick}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Soften 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}}.
Cover. Simmer gently 2 hours 30 minutes. Shred the meat with forks.
Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} until al dente. Toss with the ragù.
Grate over {{ing:parmesan}}.

swaps.text: Wide egg pasta ribbons, if you can find them

recipes.name: Chicken tagine with preserved lemon and green olives
recipes.method_note: Fragrant, salty and sour. Serve with couscous.

steps.instruction: Brown {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} in {{ing:olive-oil}}, 8 minutes.
Add sliced {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Soften 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:ginger-ground}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}} and {{ing:saffron}}.
Pour in {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Cover. Simmer 30 minutes.
Add sliced rind of {{ing:preserved-lemon}} and {{ing:olives-pitted}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Jerk chicken with rice and peas and fried plantain
recipes.method_note: Caribbean Christmas: smoky, spicy chicken, coconut rice and sweet plantain.

steps.instruction: Rub {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} with {{ing:jerk-paste}} and the juice of one {{ing:lime}}. Marinate 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Roast the chicken 30 minutes, until charred.
steps.note: 75C in the thickest part.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}, drained {{ing:kidney-beans-tinned}}, {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and {{ing:allspice}} in a pan.
Add 300 ml water and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Fry sliced {{ing:plantain}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} for 3 minutes a side.
Serve with the other lime in wedges.

recipes.name: Butter chicken (murgh makhani)
recipes.method_note: Smoky chicken in a mild, silky tomato and butter sauce.

steps.instruction: Marinate {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} in {{ing:natural-yoghurt}}, half the {{ing:garam-masala}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}. 1 hour.
Grill on high 10 minutes, until charred. Cut into pieces.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:passata}}, the rest of the garam masala and {{ing:fenugreek-seeds}}. Simmer 15 minutes. Blend.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}} and the chicken. Simmer 5 minutes.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Chicken, leek and tarragon pie with cider
recipes.method_note: A creamy pie with an aniseed hint of tarragon.

steps.instruction: Brown chunks of {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} in {{ing:butter-block}}, 8 minutes.
Add sliced {{ing:leek}}. Soften 6 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:cider-dry}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}} gradually.
Simmer 15 minutes. Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and {{ing:fresh-tarragon}}. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200C. Fill a pie dish. Top with {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Bake 35 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: 'Nduja chicken thighs with butter beans and greens
recipes.method_note: One tray, big flavour. The spicy sausage melts into the beans.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Rub {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} with half of {{ing:nduja}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Tip drained {{ing:butter-beans-tinned}}, {{ing:cherry-tomato}} and sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} into a tin. Dot with the rest of the nduja.
Sit the chicken on top. Roast 30 minutes.
steps.note: 75C in the thickest part.

steps.instruction: Stir in shredded {{ing:cavolo-nero}}. Roast 8 minutes more.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Boxing Day turkey laksa
recipes.method_note: Leftover turkey in a fragrant coconut noodle soup. A welcome change of pace.

steps.instruction: Fry {{ing:thai-red-curry-paste}} and bruised {{ing:lemongrass}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} for 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Season with {{ing:fish-sauce}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Soak {{ing:rice-noodles-dry}} in boiling water 5 minutes. Drain.
Shred leftover turkey, or {{ing:chicken-breast-roast}}, into the soup. Warm through.
Divide noodles into bowls. Ladle over. Top with {{ing:beansprouts}}, {{ing:fresh-coriander}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.

swaps.text: Most red curry paste contains shrimp; check the label

recipes.name: Mushroom, red wine and port Wellington
recipes.method_note: A dark, glossy filling in crisp pastry. Most ready-rolled puff pastry is vegan; check the label.

steps.instruction: Soften sliced {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 10 minutes.
Add chopped {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 12 minutes, until dry.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:port}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves. Bubble until almost gone.
Stir in crumbled {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}. Cool.
Wilt {{ing:spinach}}. Squeeze dry. Roast {{ing:portobello-mushroom}} whole at 200C for 10 minutes.
Lay spinach down the middle of {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Top with the filling, then the portobellos.
Fold over and seal. Brush with {{ing:oat-milk}}. Score the top.
Bake at 200C for 40 minutes, until deep golden. Rest 10 minutes.

swaps.text: Labelled vegan, or use more stock and 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar

recipes.name: Giant mushroom and barley sausage roll
recipes.method_note: Savoury, herby and meaty-textured, with no meat at all.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:pearl-barley}} for 30 minutes. Drain.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 15 minutes, until dry.
Blitz half the barley with the mushrooms. Stir in the rest.
Add chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay the filling down one long side of {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Roll over and seal. Brush with {{ing:oat-milk}}. Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Bake 40 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Sprout nasi goreng
recipes.method_note: Spicy, sticky fried rice: the best use for a surplus of sprouts.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}. Spread out to cool, ideally overnight.
Fry cubed {{ing:tofu-firm}} in 1 tbsp {{ing:vegetable-oil}} until golden, 8 minutes. Set aside.
Fry sliced {{ing:shallot}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}} in the rest of the oil 3 minutes.
Add shredded {{ing:brussels-sprouts}}. Stir-fry 4 minutes.
Add the rice, tofu, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}. Toss until hot.
Top with crushed {{ing:peanuts}}, {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:lime}} wedges.

recipes.name: Lentil, walnut and cranberry loaf with a maple glaze
recipes.method_note: A modern nut roast: moist, sliceable and glossy on top.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:lentils-green-dry}} 25 minutes. Drain.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 10 minutes.
Mix with the lentils, chopped {{ing:walnuts}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Add {{ing:soy-sauce}}. Mash a little so it holds.
Heat the oven to 180C. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Mix {{ing:tomato-purée}} with {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Spread on top.
Bake 45 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before turning out.

recipes.name: Jerk sweet potato and black bean stew with plantain
recipes.method_note: Warm Caribbean spice and sweetness, all in one pot.

steps.instruction: Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} in 1 tbsp {{ing:vegetable-oil}}, 6 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:jerk-paste}}. Fry 1 minute.
Add cubed {{ing:sweet-potato}}, drained {{ing:black-beans-tinned}} and {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Simmer 25 minutes.
Fry sliced {{ing:plantain}} in the rest of the oil 3 minutes a side.
Serve the stew with the plantain and {{ing:lime}} wedges.

swaps.text: Check the label: some contain anchovy or honey

recipes.name: Massaman squash curry with peanuts
recipes.method_note: Mild, rich and warmly spiced. Check the paste has no shrimp.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}} as the pack says.
Fry {{ing:massaman-curry-paste}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:peanut-butter}} and 200 ml water.
Add cubed {{ing:butternut-squash}}, {{ing:potato-medium}} and wedges of {{ing:onion-medium}}. Simmer 25 minutes.
Season with {{ing:tamarind-pulp}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}.
Top with {{ing:peanuts}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Chestnut, cranberry and squash filo crown
recipes.method_note: Crisp, golden layers round a festive filling, baked in a ring tin.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Roast cubed {{ing:butternut-squash}} in 2 tbsp {{ing:olive-oil}} 25 minutes.
Soften sliced {{ing:red-onion}} in 1 tbsp oil 10 minutes. Wilt in {{ing:spinach}}.
Mix with the squash, chopped {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}}, {{ing:fresh-sage}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Line a ring tin with {{ing:filo-pastry}}, brushing with oil, sheets overhanging.
Fill. Fold the pastry over. Brush with the last of the oil.
Bake 35 minutes. Turn out.
Warm {{ing:cranberries}} with {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Spoon over the top.

recipes.name: Whole roast aubergines with tahini, pomegranate and herbs
recipes.method_note: Smoky, silky flesh under a sharp, nutty dressing.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Prick {{ing:aubergine}} all over.
Roast 50 minutes, until collapsed.
Split open. Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt.
Whisk {{ing:tahini}}, {{ing:lemon}} juice, grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and water to a sauce.
Spoon over. Drizzle with {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}}.
Scatter with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.

recipes.name: Smoky mushroom stroganoff
recipes.method_note: Creamy, paprika-rich and on the table in 25 minutes.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} as the pack says.
Soften sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 6 minutes.
Add sliced {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 8 minutes, until golden.
Stir in {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Add {{ing:oat-cream}}. Simmer 3 minutes.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and chopped {{ing:gherkins}}.

recipes.name: Pot-roast celeriac with mushroom gravy
recipes.method_note: A whole root cooked slowly until tender, carved like a joint.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Rub {{ing:celeriac}}, peeled, with 2 tbsp {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt.
Sit in a casserole with {{ing:fresh-thyme}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and 200 ml water.
Cover. Roast 90 minutes. Uncover, 30 minutes more, basting.
Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} in the hot {{ing:stock-vegetable}} 20 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} in the rest of the oil 10 minutes.
