Add the stock, chopped shiitake and {{ing:soy-sauce}}. Thicken with {{ing:cornflour}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Carve the celeriac into wedges. Pour over the gravy.

swaps.text: Tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Whole roast cauliflower on a saffron chickpea pilaf
recipes.method_note: A centrepiece and its side in one: golden cauliflower on fragrant rice.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:cauliflower-head}} whole for 8 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oven to 200C. Rub with 2 tbsp {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:ras-el-hanout}}.
Roast 45 minutes, until golden.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in the rest of the oil 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}, drained {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}, {{ing:saffron}}, {{ing:dried-apricots}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Cover. 15 minutes.
Sit the cauliflower on the rice. Scatter with toasted {{ing:almonds}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Black lentil and kidney bean dal, makhani style
recipes.method_note: Deep, smoky and creamy, made with oat cream instead of butter.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:lentils-green-dry}} 30 minutes, until soft.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:garam-masala}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Add {{ing:passata}}, the lentils and drained {{ing:kidney-beans-tinned}}. Simmer 30 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:oat-cream}}. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Paneer butter masala
recipes.method_note: A rich, mild curry for a vegetarian feast.

steps.instruction: Fry cubed {{ing:paneer}} in half of {{ing:butter-block}} 5 minutes, until golden. Set aside.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in the rest of the butter 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:garam-masala}}, {{ing:chilli-powder}} and {{ing:fenugreek-seeds}}.
Add {{ing:passata}} and {{ing:cashews}}. Simmer 10 minutes. Blend smooth.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}} and the paneer. Simmer 5 minutes.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Saag paneer
recipes.method_note: Spinach and golden cheese, gently spiced.

steps.instruction: Fry cubed {{ing:paneer}} in {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 5 minutes. Set aside.
Add {{ing:cumin-ground}}, chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}. Cook 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:garam-masala}}.
Add {{ing:spinach}} in handfuls until wilted. Blend roughly.
Stir in {{ing:natural-yoghurt}} and the paneer. Warm through.

recipes.name: Spiced whole cauliflower with a jewelled nut pilaf and yoghurt
recipes.method_note: Works as the centrepiece and as a show-stopping side.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:cauliflower-head}} whole 8 minutes. Drain.
Mix half of {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} with {{ing:garam-masala}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}} and lemon juice. Coat the cauliflower.
Roast at 200C for 45 minutes, until charred.
Fry {{ing:cashews}} and {{ing:pistachios}} in {{ing:butter-block}} until golden.
Add {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}, {{ing:sultanas}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Cover. Cook 15 minutes.
Serve the cauliflower on the rice with the rest of the yoghurt and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Add {{ing:lemon}} wedges.

recipes.name: Leek, potato and Cheddar pie with mustard
recipes.method_note: A deep, cheesy pie for a cold evening.

steps.instruction: Boil sliced {{ing:potato-medium}} 8 minutes. Drain.
Soften sliced {{ing:leek}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 10 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:milk-whole}}. Stir until thick.
Add {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}, {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}} and the potatoes. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200C. Line a pie dish with two thirds of {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Fill.
Top with the rest. Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Bake 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Beetroot and goats' cheese tarte tatin
recipes.method_note: Ruby beetroot in a sticky balsamic glaze, under flaky pastry.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} in an ovenproof pan. Bubble 2 minutes.
Lay in sliced cooked {{ing:beetroot}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Cover with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Tuck in the edges.
Bake 25 minutes. Rest 5 minutes. Turn out.
Top with {{ing:goats-cheese}}, {{ing:walnuts}} and {{ing:rocket}}.

recipes.name: Squash, Stilton and sage galette
recipes.method_note: A free-form tart. Rustic and generous.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Slice {{ing:butternut-squash}} thinly. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and sliced {{ing:red-onion}}.
Roll {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}} into a 30 cm round on a tray.
Pile the squash in the middle, leaving a 5 cm border.
Crumble over {{ing:stilton}}. Add {{ing:fresh-sage}} and {{ing:walnuts}}.
Fold the border up. Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}.
Bake 40 minutes. Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}.

recipes.name: Potato, onion and Camembert tartiflette
recipes.method_note: An Alpine bake: potatoes and melting cheese. Lovely after a winter walk.

steps.instruction: Boil sliced {{ing:potato-medium}} 8 minutes. Drain.
Soften sliced {{ing:onion-large}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 12 minutes.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Layer potatoes and onions in a dish with {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Halve {{ing:camembert}} through the middle. Lay on top, rind up.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling.

swaps.text: Reblochon, the traditional cheese, if you can find it
Check for a vegetarian rennet

recipes.name: Spinach and feta filo pie
recipes.method_note: Crisp layers, herby filling. A Greek celebration pie.

steps.instruction: Wilt {{ing:spinach}}. Cool and squeeze very dry.
Mix with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}, crumbled {{ing:feta}}, {{ing:ricotta}}, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:fresh-dill}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Heat the oven to 190C. Brush a tin with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Layer five sheets of {{ing:filo-pastry}}, brushing each with oil.
Spread the filling. Scrunch the rest of the filo on top. Brush with oil.
Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}}. Bake 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Wild mushroom and chestnut ragù on soft polenta
recipes.method_note: Earthy and rich, on a buttery cloud of polenta.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} in 200 ml boiling water 15 minutes.
Soften {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 6 minutes. Add {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Add the shiitake and water, {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}, {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}}. Simmer 20 minutes.
Whisk {{ing:polenta-dry}} into 1 litre boiling salted water. Stir 5 minutes.
Beat in {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:parmesan}}.
Spoon the ragù over the polenta.

swaps.text: A vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Halloumi, roast roots and freekeh traybake
recipes.method_note: One tray, roasted until golden, with a pomegranate dressing.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:freekeh}} in {{ing:stock-vegetable}} 20 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oven to 200C. Chop {{ing:carrot-medium}}, {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:butternut-squash}}.
Toss with 3 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:ras-el-hanout}}. Roast 30 minutes.
Stir in the freekeh. Lay sliced {{ing:halloumi}} on top. Roast 15 minutes.
Whisk the last of the oil with {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}}. Drizzle over. Scatter {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Mushroom and truffle pasta bake
recipes.method_note: A crowd-pleasing bake for Christmas Eve.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes short of the pack time. Drain.
Fry sliced {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in half of {{ing:butter-block}} 8 minutes.
Melt the rest of the butter. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} until thick.
Stir in {{ing:gruyere}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and {{ing:truffle-oil}}.
Fold in the pasta and mushrooms. Tip into a dish. Top with {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate and clementine cassata semifreddo
recipes.method_note: Keeps ready in the freezer, then brings drama to the table.

steps.instruction: Line a 1 kg loaf tin with cling film.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks.
Beat {{ing:condensed-milk}} with {{ing:ricotta}} and the zest of {{ing:clementine}}.
Fold in the cream, chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}, {{ing:pistachios}}, {{ing:glace-cherries}} and {{ing:mixed-peel}}.
Spoon into the tin. Freeze at least 6 hours.
Turn out 10 minutes before serving. Top with clementine slices.

recipes.name: Panettone tiramisu
recipes.method_note: Make the day before. Panettone soaks up the coffee beautifully.

steps.instruction: Brew 250 ml strong coffee from {{ing:coffee-ground}}. Stir in {{ing:orange-liqueur}}. Cool.
Whisk {{ing:mascarpone}}, {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:icing-sugar}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}} until thick.
Slice {{ing:panettone}}. Dip each slice in the coffee. Line a dish.
Spread over half the cream. Repeat the layers.
Chill at least 6 hours.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}. Grate over {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.

recipes.name: Chocolate salami with pistachios and cherries
recipes.method_note: An Italian no-bake treat, sliced like salami. Makes a lovely gift.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}} and {{ing:butter-block}} together.
Stir in {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Fold in broken {{ing:digestive-biscuit}}, {{ing:pistachios}} and chopped {{ing:glace-cherries}}.
Chill 30 minutes, until firm enough to shape.
Roll into a log in baking paper. Twist the ends.
Chill 4 hours. Roll in {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Slice.

recipes.name: Pistachio and sour cherry pavlova
recipes.method_note: Crisp shell, marshmallow middle, cream and jewel-red cherries.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 140C. Line a tray.
Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} to stiff peaks. Add {{ing:sugar-caster}} a spoon at a time until glossy.
Fold in {{ing:cornflour}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}.
Spread into a 22 cm round. Bake 70 minutes. Cool in the oven.
Simmer {{ing:sour-cherries-dried}} and half of {{ing:cherries}} 5 minutes to a sauce.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}. Fold in {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} and {{ing:rose-water}}.
Pile on the meringue. Top with the rest of the cherries, the sauce and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

recipes.name: Chocolate and clementine Christmas pudding
recipes.method_note: For anyone who finds the classic too heavy. Steamed, dark and orange-scented.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:raisins}} and {{ing:dried-cranberries}} in {{ing:spirit-40}} and clementine juice overnight.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:cocoa-powder}}, {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:mixed-spice}}.
Stir in the fruit, chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate}} and the zest of {{ing:clementine}}.
Spoon into a buttered 1.2 litre basin. Cover with pleated foil. Tie with string.
Steam 2 hours 30 minutes, topping up the water.

recipes.name: Mincemeat and almond frangipane tart
recipes.method_note: All the flavour of mince pies in one elegant tart.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tart tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake blind 15 minutes.
Spread {{ing:mincemeat}} over the base.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Spread over the mincemeat. Scatter flaked {{ing:almonds}}.
Turn to 170C. Bake 35 minutes, until golden and set.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.

recipes.name: Pistachio crumble mince pies
recipes.method_note: Classic mince pies with a green, nutty crumble lid.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a 12-hole tin with rounds of {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Stir the zest of {{ing:orange}} into {{ing:mincemeat}}. Fill the cases.
Rub {{ing:butter-block}} into {{ing:flour-plain}}. Stir in {{ing:sugar-demerara}} and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.
Scatter over the pies.
Bake 20 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Malted milk chocolate tart
recipes.method_note: Silky, toasty and nostalgic. Malt is the flavour of the season.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:digestive-biscuit}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}.
Press into a 23 cm tart tin. Chill 20 minutes.
Heat {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:malted-milk-powder}} until steaming.
Pour over chopped {{ing:milk-chocolate-bar}} and {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Stir until glossy.
Add {{ing:salt}}. Pour into the base.
Chill 3 hours, until set.

recipes.name: No-churn malted ice cream
recipes.method_note: Three ingredients and the freezer. No machine needed.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:condensed-milk}} with {{ing:malted-milk-powder}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks.
Fold the two together.
Freeze in a tub for 6 hours.

swaps.text: Leave it out and add 1 tbsp golden syrup, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Sticky ginger parkin
recipes.method_note: A Yorkshire oat cake that gets stickier the longer you keep it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C. Line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:golden-syrup}}, {{ing:black-treacle}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} together.
Mix {{ing:oats-rolled}}, {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}.
Stir in the syrup, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Pour into the tin. Bake 70 minutes.
Cool. Wrap and keep 2 days before eating.

recipes.name: Roast figs with orange blossom labneh and honey
recipes.method_note: Light and fragrant, after a heavy main.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Halve {{ing:figs-fresh}}.
Drizzle with half of {{ing:honey}} and the juice of {{ing:orange}}.
Roast 12 minutes.
Beat {{ing:labneh}} with {{ing:orange-blossom-water}} and orange zest.
Serve the figs on the labneh. Drizzle with honey. Scatter {{ing:pistachios}}.

recipes.name: Whole clementine and almond cake
recipes.method_note: Moist, fragrant and flourless. Whole boiled fruit, skins and all.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:clementine}} whole in water for 2 hours. Cool.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 20 cm springform tin.
Halve the fruit, remove any pips, and blend to a pulp.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:baking-powder}}.
Pour into the tin. Bake 50 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin. Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.

swaps.text: Check it is gluten free

recipes.name: Tahini swirl chocolate brownies
recipes.method_note: Fudgy brownies with a salty, nutty ripple.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}} and {{ing:butter-block}}.
Whisk {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:egg-large}} until pale. Fold in the chocolate.
Fold in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.
Pour into the tin. Dot with {{ing:tahini}}. Swirl with a skewer. Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Bake 25 minutes, still soft in the middle. Cool before cutting.

recipes.name: Halva and honey baked cheesecake
recipes.method_note: Creamy, nutty and not too sweet.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Crush {{ing:digestive-biscuit}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}. Press into a 23 cm tin.
Beat {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:soured-cream}} and {{ing:tahini}} until smooth.
Fold in two thirds of {{ing:halva}}, crumbled.
Pour over the base. Bake 55 minutes, with a wobble in the middle.
Cool in the oven with the door open. Chill overnight.
Top with the rest of the halva and {{ing:honey}}.

recipes.name: Saffron and pistachio rice pudding (kheer)
recipes.method_note: Fragrant and creamy, served warm or cold.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}. Soak 20 minutes.
Bring {{ing:milk-whole}} to the boil with crushed {{ing:cardamom}}.
Add the rice. Simmer gently, stirring often, 45 minutes, until thick.
Stir in {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:saffron}} and {{ing:rose-water}}.
Top with chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:almonds}}.

recipes.name: Mango and cardamom kulfi
recipes.method_note: A dense Indian ice cream that needs no churning.

steps.instruction: Blend the flesh of {{ing:mango}} until smooth.
Mix with {{ing:condensed-milk}}, {{ing:double-cream}} and ground seeds from {{ing:cardamom}}.
Pour into moulds or a tin. Freeze 6 hours.
Turn out. Scatter chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

recipes.name: Chocolate orange baked cheesecake
recipes.method_note: Rich, dense and very festive.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Crush {{ing:chocolate-digestive}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}. Press into a 23 cm tin.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Cool a little.
Beat {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:double-cream}}.
Beat in the chocolate, {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Pour over the base. Bake 55 minutes. Cool in the oven.
Chill overnight. Top with orange segments.

recipes.name: Chocolate and chestnut roulade
recipes.method_note: Flourless and light. It is meant to crack as you roll it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23 x 33 cm tin.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Cool a little.
Whisk the yolks of {{ing:egg-large}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} until pale. Fold in the chocolate.
Whisk the whites stiff. Fold in. Spread in the tin.
Bake 20 minutes. Cool under a damp tea towel.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}. Fold in {{ing:chestnut-puree-sweet}} and {{ing:spirit-40}}.
Turn the sponge onto paper dusted with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Spread with cream. Roll up.

recipes.name: Black Forest trifle
recipes.method_note: Chocolate, cherries and kirsch-style soak, in deep layers.

steps.instruction: Simmer stoned {{ing:cherries}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} 5 minutes. Cool. Stir in {{ing:spirit-40}}.
Line a bowl with slices of {{ing:cake-sponge}}. Spoon over the cherries and juice.
Melt half of {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Stir into {{ing:custard-ready}}. Pour over.
Chill 1 hour.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Spread on top.
Grate over the rest of the chocolate.

recipes.name: Ginger nut, pear and custard trifle
recipes.method_note: Warm spice, soft pears and crunchy biscuit.

steps.instruction: Poach sliced {{ing:pear}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} and a splash of water 8 minutes.
Break {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}} into a bowl. Sprinkle with {{ing:sherry}}.
Spoon over the pears and chopped {{ing:stem-ginger}}.
Pour over {{ing:custard-ready}}. Chill 1 hour.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}. Spread on top. Add crushed biscuit if you kept some.

recipes.name: Clementine and cranberry Eton mess
recipes.method_note: Smashed meringue, cream and sharp red fruit, all in a few minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 120C. Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} stiff. Whisk in half of {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Spoon onto a tray. Bake 60 minutes. Cool.
Simmer {{ing:cranberries}} with the rest of the sugar and clementine juice 6 minutes. Cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}. Fold in {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
Crush the meringues. Fold through the cream with the cranberries and segments of {{ing:clementine}}.

recipes.name: Slow-poached quince with vanilla cream
recipes.method_note: Hours of gentle heat turn quince deep rose-pink and perfumed.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C. Peel {{ing:quince}}. Quarter and core.
Put in a dish with {{ing:sugar-caster}}, strips of {{ing:lemon}} peel, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and 600 ml water.
Cover. Bake 3 hours, until deep pink.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:icing-sugar}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Serve the quince warm with its syrup and the cream.

recipes.name: Plum and almond crumble cake
recipes.method_note: A tender cake with jammy plums and a crunchy top.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23 cm tin.
Beat 150 g of {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:ground-almonds}}. Spread in the tin.
Press halved {{ing:plums}} into the top.
Rub the rest of the butter into {{ing:flour-plain}}. Stir in {{ing:sugar-demerara}}, {{ing:almonds}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Scatter over. Bake 55 minutes.

recipes.name: Apple and blackberry crumble with hazelnuts
recipes.method_note: A crunchy, nutty topping over soft, purple fruit.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Peel and chop {{ing:apple-medium}}. Toss with {{ing:blackberries}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a dish.
Rub {{ing:butter-block}} into {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Stir in {{ing:sugar-demerara}}, chopped {{ing:hazelnuts}} and {{ing:oats-rolled}}.
Scatter over the fruit. Bake 40 minutes.
Serve with warm {{ing:custard-ready}}.

recipes.name: Pear and ginger upside-down cake
recipes.method_note: Caramel pears on a dark, sticky ginger sponge.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C. Melt 30 g of {{ing:butter-block}} with 50 g of {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} in a 23 cm tin.
Lay sliced {{ing:pear}} over the caramel.
Melt the rest of the butter, sugar, {{ing:golden-syrup}} and {{ing:black-treacle}}.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}. Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}.
Stir in chopped {{ing:stem-ginger}}. Pour over the pears.
Bake 45 minutes. Turn out warm.

recipes.name: Forced rhubarb and almond cake
recipes.method_note: Pink, sharp and tender. Lovely with cream.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23 cm tin.
Cut {{ing:rhubarb}} into lengths. Toss with 25 g of {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}} with the rest of the sugar. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:ground-almonds}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Spread in the tin. Lay the rhubarb on top. Scatter {{ing:almonds}}.
Bake 50 minutes.

recipes.name: Maple, chocolate and pecan pie
recipes.method_note: Gooey, nutty and rich. A small slice goes a long way.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake blind 15 minutes.
Whisk melted {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}, {{ing:egg-large}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Scatter {{ing:pecans}} and chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate}} in the case. Pour over the filling.
Turn to 170C. Bake 40 minutes, until set at the edges.
steps.note: It firms up as it cools.

recipes.name: Spiced sweet potato pie
recipes.method_note: A Southern holiday pie: velvety, warmly spiced, not too sweet.

steps.instruction: Bake {{ing:sweet-potato}} at 200C for 50 minutes. Scoop out the flesh.
Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake blind 15 minutes.
Blend the sweet potato with {{ing:condensed-milk}}, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}, {{ing:nutmeg}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}.
Add {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Pour into the case.
Bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to serve.

recipes.name: Banoffee pie
recipes.method_note: Biscuit, caramel, bananas and cream. No baking at all.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:digestive-biscuit}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}.
Press into a 23 cm tin. Chill 20 minutes.
Spread {{ing:dulce-de-leche}} over the base.
Slice {{ing:banana-medium}} over the caramel.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Spread on top.
Grate over {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.

recipes.name: Dark chocolate mousse with olive oil and sea salt
recipes.method_note: Intense and silky, with a peppery, grassy finish from the oil.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir in 3 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Cool a little.
Stir in the yolks of {{ing:egg-large}}.
Whisk the whites stiff. Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Fold the whites into the chocolate gently.
Spoon into glasses. Chill 4 hours.
Drizzle with the rest of the oil. Sprinkle with a little {{ing:salt}}.

recipes.name: White chocolate and cardamom mousse with raspberries
recipes.method_note: Creamy and fragrant, with sharp berries to cut through.

steps.instruction: Warm 100 ml of {{ing:double-cream}} with crushed {{ing:cardamom}}. Leave 10 minutes. Strain.
Pour over chopped {{ing:white-chocolate}}. Stir until smooth. Cool.
Whip the rest of the cream softly. Fold in with {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
Layer in glasses with {{ing:raspberries}}.
Chill 2 hours. Top with {{ing:pistachios}}.

recipes.name: Lemon posset with shortbread
recipes.method_note: Three ingredients, set by the lemon juice alone.

steps.instruction: Bring {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} to the boil. Bubble 3 minutes.
Take off the heat. Stir in the juice and zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Pour into six glasses. Chill 4 hours, until set.
Top with {{ing:raspberries}}. Serve with {{ing:shortbread}}.

recipes.name: Passion fruit posset
recipes.method_note: Tropical and tangy. Lovely after a rich main.

steps.instruction: Bring {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} to the boil. Bubble 3 minutes.
Stir in the pulp of four {{ing:passion-fruit}}, sieved, and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Pour into glasses. Chill 4 hours.
Spoon over the pulp of the rest of the passion fruit.

recipes.name: Pomegranate and sparkling wine granita
recipes.method_note: Icy, sparkling and very pretty. Scrape it every half hour.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:sugar-caster}} in 100 ml of {{ing:pomegranate-juice}} until dissolved.
Stir in the rest of the juice, {{ing:sparkling-wine}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Pour into a shallow tray. Freeze, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes, for 4 hours.
Serve in glasses with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Sparkling water, for an alcohol-free version

recipes.name: Mulled plums with cinnamon cream
recipes.method_note: Plums poached in spiced red wine until glossy.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and peel of {{ing:orange}} 5 minutes.
Add halved {{ing:plums}}. Poach 8 minutes, until soft.
Lift out the plums. Bubble the syrup 5 minutes, until thick.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Serve the plums in their syrup with the cream.

recipes.name: Christmas baked Alaska
recipes.method_note: Ice cream and sponge under toasted meringue. Assemble and freeze ahead.

steps.instruction: Soften {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}}. Stir in {{ing:mincemeat}}. Press into a lined bowl. Freeze 4 hours.
Cut a round of {{ing:cake-sponge}} to fit. Sprinkle with {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Turn the ice cream dome onto the sponge.
Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} stiff. Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}} until glossy.
Spread over the dome, sealing to the sponge. Freeze until needed.
Bake at 230C for 4 minutes, until browned. Serve at once.

recipes.name: Chocolate croissant bread and butter pudding
recipes.method_note: Leftover croissants turned into a rich, custardy bake.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C. Tear {{ing:croissant}} into a buttered dish.
Tuck in chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Pour over. Leave 15 minutes to soak.
Bake 35 minutes, until puffed and set.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.

recipes.name: Christmas pudding no-churn ice cream
recipes.method_note: All the flavour of the pudding, cool and creamy.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:raisins}} and {{ing:sultanas}} in {{ing:spirit-40}} 1 hour.
Whisk {{ing:condensed-milk}} with {{ing:mixed-spice}}.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks. Fold in.
Fold in the fruit and crushed {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}}.
Freeze 6 hours.

recipes.name: Apple and mincemeat strudel
recipes.method_note: Crisp filo rolled round apples and festive fruit.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Peel and dice {{ing:apple-medium}}. Mix with {{ing:mincemeat}}.
Lay out {{ing:filo-pastry}}, brushing each sheet with melted {{ing:butter-block}}.
Scatter with {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}. Spread the filling along one long edge.
Roll up. Tuck the ends. Brush with butter.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.

recipes.name: Pistachio and cinnamon baklava
recipes.method_note: Crisp layers soaked in honey syrup. Make a day ahead.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Chop {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:walnuts}}. Mix with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Layer six sheets of {{ing:filo-pastry}} in a tin, brushing each with melted {{ing:butter-block}}.
Spread the nuts. Layer the rest of the filo, buttering each.
Cut into diamonds. Bake 40 minutes, until golden.
Simmer {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, 100 ml water and {{ing:lemon}} juice 5 minutes. Add {{ing:orange-blossom-water}}.
Pour over the hot baklava. Leave 4 hours.

recipes.name: Chocolate and hazelnut praline tart
recipes.method_note: Crisp pastry, silky ganache and a crackling nut topping.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake blind 25 minutes, until crisp. Cool.
Melt {{ing:sugar-caster}} to a golden caramel. Stir in toasted {{ing:hazelnuts}}. Pour onto paper. Cool and crush.
Heat {{ing:double-cream}}. Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate}} and {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir smooth.
Add {{ing:salt}}. Pour into the case.
Chill 2 hours. Scatter with the praline.

recipes.name: Hot chocolate self-saucing pudding
recipes.method_note: A sponge on top, a pool of chocolate sauce beneath. Magic in the oven.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Butter a 1.5 litre dish.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, half of {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Beat in {{ing:milk-whole}}, melted {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:egg-medium}}. Spread in the dish.
Mix {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} with the rest of the cocoa. Scatter over.
Pour over 300 ml boiling water. Do not stir.
Bake 35 minutes. Serve with {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}}.

recipes.name: Steamed treacle sponge
recipes.method_note: Golden syrup soaks into a light sponge. Pure nostalgia.

steps.instruction: Butter a 1.2 litre basin. Spoon {{ing:golden-syrup}} into the bottom.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, lemon zest and {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Spoon into the basin. Cover with pleated foil. Tie.
Steam 90 minutes.
Turn out. Serve with warm {{ing:custard-ready}} and a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Cranberry and orange Bakewell tart
recipes.method_note: A festive twist on the classic, with sharp cranberries under the almond.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake blind 15 minutes.
Spread {{ing:cranberry-sauce}} over the base.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:ground-almonds}} and orange zest.
Spread over. Scatter {{ing:almonds}}.
Bake at 170C for 35 minutes.
Mix {{ing:icing-sugar}} with orange juice from {{ing:orange}}. Drizzle over.

recipes.name: Cherry Bakewell tart
recipes.method_note: Sour cherries in place of jam give a brighter tart.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake blind 15 minutes.
Simmer stoned {{ing:cherries}} with 25 g of {{ing:sugar-caster}} 8 minutes, until jammy.
Spread over the base.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}}, the rest of the sugar, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Spread over. Scatter {{ing:almonds}}.
Bake at 170C for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Apricot and almond galette
recipes.method_note: A rustic open tart. Good warm with cream.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:dried-apricots}} in the juice of {{ing:orange}} and 100 ml water, 10 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Roll {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}} into a 30 cm round on a tray.
Mix {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Scatter in the middle.
Arrange the apricots on top. Fold the edges in.
Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Scatter {{ing:sugar-demerara}}.
Bake 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate orange pots de crème
recipes.method_note: Baked custards: dense, smooth and deeply chocolatey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} with the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Stir smooth.
Whisk {{ing:egg-yolk}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Whisk in the chocolate.
Pour into six ramekins in a tray of hot water. Bake 30 minutes.
Cool. Chill 3 hours.

recipes.name: Orange crème caramel
recipes.method_note: Wobbling custards in amber caramel. Make a day ahead.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Melt 125 g of {{ing:sugar-caster}} to a deep amber caramel. Pour into six ramekins.
Warm {{ing:milk-whole}} with the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, the rest of the sugar and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Whisk in the milk.
Strain into the ramekins. Bake in a water bath 40 minutes.
Chill overnight. Run a knife round and turn out.

recipes.name: Coconut and lime tres leches cake
recipes.method_note: A light sponge soaked in three milks. Cool and refreshing.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23 x 33 cm tin.
Whisk {{ing:egg-large}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} until thick and pale.
Fold in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:baking-powder}}.
Spread in the tin. Bake 25 minutes. Prick all over.
Mix {{ing:condensed-milk}}, {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}. Pour over the warm cake.
Chill 4 hours.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}. Spread on top. Finish with zest of {{ing:lime}} and toasted {{ing:desiccated-coconut}}.

recipes.name: Raspberry and pistachio meringue roulade
recipes.method_note: Crisp outside, soft inside, rolled round cream and berries.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23 x 33 cm tin.
Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} stiff. Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}} until glossy. Fold in {{ing:cornflour}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}.
Spread in the tin. Scatter {{ing:pistachios}}. Bake 20 minutes.
Turn onto paper dusted with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}. Spread over. Scatter {{ing:raspberries}}.
Roll up from a long side.

recipes.name: Mango, lime and passion fruit pavlova wreath
recipes.method_note: A ring of meringue for a sunnier Christmas table.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 130C. Draw a 25 cm ring on baking paper.
Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} stiff. Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}} until glossy. Fold in {{ing:cornflour}}.
Spoon round the ring. Bake 75 minutes. Cool in the oven.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with the zest of {{ing:lime}}.
Spoon onto the ring. Top with diced {{ing:mango}} and the pulp of {{ing:passion-fruit}}.
Scatter {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Chocolate and tahini tart
recipes.method_note: Rich and silky, on a date and oat base. No baking needed.

steps.instruction: Blitz {{ing:oats-rolled}}, {{ing:dates-pitted}} and {{ing:coconut-cream}}. Press into a 23 cm tin.
Chill 30 minutes.
Heat {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir smooth.
Stir in {{ing:tahini}} and {{ing:maple-syrup}}.
Pour into the base. Chill 4 hours.
Scatter toasted {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Check it is labelled dairy free
Gluten-free oats, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Sticky toffee date pudding
recipes.method_note: Moist, dark sponge drenched in toffee sauce, with no eggs or dairy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 cm square tin.
Pour 250 ml boiling water over chopped {{ing:dates-pitted}} and {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}. Leave 10 minutes.
Beat 75 g of {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} with 100 g of {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}. Stir in {{ing:oat-milk}} and the dates.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}.
Bake 35 minutes.
Simmer the rest of the spread and sugar with {{ing:golden-syrup}} and {{ing:oat-cream}} 3 minutes. Pour over.

recipes.name: Apple and cranberry oat crumble
recipes.method_note: Sharp-sweet fruit under a crisp, golden oat crumble.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Toss chopped {{ing:apple-medium}} and {{ing:cranberries}} with {{ing:maple-syrup}} in a dish.
Rub {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} into {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Stir in {{ing:oats-rolled}}, {{ing:sugar-demerara}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Scatter over. Bake 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Silken chocolate orange pots
recipes.method_note: Blended silken tofu makes a mousse that tastes of nothing but chocolate.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Cool a little.
Blend with {{ing:tofu-silken}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}} until silky.
Spoon into six pots. Chill 3 hours.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

recipes.name: Pear and ginger loaf cake
recipes.method_note: Moist and gently spiced, made with oil.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 1 kg loaf tin.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}, {{ing:ginger-ground}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Whisk {{ing:vegetable-oil}}, {{ing:oat-milk}} and {{ing:golden-syrup}}. Stir in.
Fold in diced {{ing:pear}} and chopped {{ing:stem-ginger}}.
Bake 55 minutes.

recipes.name: Mincemeat crumble bars
recipes.method_note: All the joy of mince pies, cut into squares. Check the mincemeat uses vegetable suet.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 x 30 cm tin.
Rub {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} into {{ing:flour-plain}}. Stir in {{ing:oats-rolled}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}.
Press two thirds into the tin. Bake 15 minutes.
Stir the zest of {{ing:orange}} into {{ing:mincemeat}}. Spread over.
Scatter the rest of the crumble and {{ing:almonds}}.
Bake 30 minutes. Cool before cutting.

recipes.name: Baked apples with maple, pecans and dates
recipes.method_note: Soft, sweet and warming. The kitchen smells wonderful.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Core {{ing:apple-medium}}. Score round the middle.
Mix chopped {{ing:pecans}}, {{ing:dates-pitted}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}. Stuff the apples.
Drizzle with {{ing:maple-syrup}} and a splash of water.
Bake 40 minutes, basting once.
Serve with {{ing:oat-cream}}.

recipes.name: Brandy and orange chocolate truffles
recipes.method_note: To finish the meal with coffee, or wrap as gifts.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:double-cream}} until steaming. Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Stir smooth with {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:spirit-40}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Chill 3 hours, until firm.
Scoop and roll into 24 balls. Roll in {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

recipes.name: Chestnut and dark chocolate truffles
recipes.method_note: Earthy, sweet and very rich. No cream needed.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Beat in {{ing:chestnut-puree-sweet}} and {{ing:spirit-40}}.
Chill 2 hours.
Roll into 24 balls. Roll in {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

swaps.text: Check the label is free of dairy

recipes.name: No-bake gingerbread cheesecake
recipes.method_note: A ginger biscuit base and a spiced, creamy filling.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}. Press into a 23 cm tin.
Beat {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:icing-sugar}}, {{ing:black-treacle}}, {{ing:ginger-ground}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks. Fold in.
Spread over the base. Chill 6 hours.

recipes.name: Pistachio affogato
recipes.method_note: Hot espresso over cold ice cream: the fastest pudding there is.

steps.instruction: Make four shots of espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}.
Put two scoops of {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}} in each glass.
Pour over the hot coffee.
Scatter chopped {{ing:pistachios}}. Grate over {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.

recipes.name: Warm sherry zabaglione with berries
recipes.method_note: A frothy, warm custard whisked over simmering water.

steps.instruction: Divide {{ing:raspberries}} and {{ing:blueberries}} between four glasses.
Whisk {{ing:egg-yolk}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:sherry}} in a bowl over simmering water.
Keep whisking 8 minutes, until thick and tripled in volume.
Spoon over the fruit. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Roast plums with port and mascarpone
recipes.method_note: Ten minutes to prepare, and all the warmth of the season.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Halve {{ing:plums}}. Lay cut side up in a dish.
Pour over {{ing:port}}. Scatter {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}. Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}.
Roast 20 minutes.
Beat {{ing:mascarpone}} with the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Serve the plums in their syrup with the mascarpone.

recipes.name: No-churn pistachio and cardamom ice cream
recipes.method_note: Green, nutty and perfumed. Pistachio is the flavour of the year.

steps.instruction: Blitz 80 g of {{ing:pistachios}} to a paste.
Whisk with {{ing:condensed-milk}}, ground seeds of {{ing:cardamom}} and {{ing:rose-water}}.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks. Fold in.
Fold in the rest of the pistachios, chopped.
Freeze 6 hours.

recipes.name: Maple, Parmesan and black pepper parsnips
recipes.method_note: Sticky, peppery and salty. The cheese crisps in the oven.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Quarter {{ing:parsnip}} lengthways.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt. Roast 30 minutes.
Drizzle with {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Add {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}. Toss.
Scatter with grated {{ing:parmesan}}. Roast 10 minutes more, until crisp.

swaps.text: A vegetarian hard cheese, or nutritional yeast for a vegan version

recipes.name: Fondant swede gratin with thyme
recipes.method_note: Swede baked slowly in cream until it melts. A humble root made grand.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C. Butter a baking dish with {{ing:butter-block}}.
Peel {{ing:swede}}. Slice very thinly.
Warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Layer the swede in the dish, seasoning as you go. Pour over the cream.
Cover with foil. Bake 60 minutes.
Uncover. Top with grated {{ing:gruyere}}. Bake 25 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Harissa and honey carrots with pomegranate
recipes.method_note: Smoky heat, sticky sweetness and a jewel-like finish.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Halve {{ing:carrot-medium}} lengthways.
Mix {{ing:harissa-paste}}, {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Toss with the carrots.
Roast 35 minutes, until tender and charred.
Scatter with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Sprouts with burnt butter and black garlic
recipes.method_note: Sweet, savoury black garlic and nutty butter. Sprouts for people who think they dislike sprouts.

steps.instruction: Halve {{ing:brussels-sprouts}}.
Fry cut side down in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 6 minutes, until charred.
Add {{ing:butter-block}}. Cook 2 minutes, until it browns and smells nutty.
Stir in mashed {{ing:black-garlic}}. Toss to coat.
Finish with {{ing:lemon}} juice and chopped {{ing:hazelnuts}}.

recipes.name: Apricot, pecan and sage stuffing with a herb sauce
recipes.method_note: Bready, fruity, crunchy. The green herb sauce lifts it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 10 minutes.
Tear {{ing:sourdough}} into small pieces. Mix with the onions.
Add chopped {{ing:dried-apricots}}, {{ing:pecans}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Stir through.
Spread in a dish. Bake 35 minutes, until crisp on top.
Blend {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:lemon}} juice. Spoon over to serve.

recipes.name: Celebration pilaf with herbs, nuts and barberry-style cranberries
recipes.method_note: A fragrant rice to sit beside any roast. Saffron, nuts and sharp fruit.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} until the water runs clear.
Soften sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:cardamom}} and {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} for 8 minutes.
Stir in the rice to coat.
Soak {{ing:saffron}} in 2 tbsp hot water. Add with {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and salt.
Cover. Cook on the lowest heat 12 minutes. Rest 10 minutes, lid on.
Fold in {{ing:dried-cranberries}}, {{ing:pistachios}}, toasted {{ing:almonds}}, {{ing:fresh-dill}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Charred leeks with miso butter and chives
recipes.method_note: Sweet, silky leeks with a deep savoury glaze.

steps.instruction: Halve {{ing:leek}} lengthways. Wash out any grit.
Steam 8 minutes, until soft.
Char cut side down in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 4 minutes.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:miso-paste}} and {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Melt over the leeks.
Scatter with {{ing:chives}} and toasted {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Check the label: most miso is gluten free, barley miso is not

recipes.name: Lemon zest and coriander seed roast potatoes
recipes.method_note: Crisp, golden and fragrant. A bright change from the usual roasties.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Peel and chunk {{ing:potato-large}}.
Boil 8 minutes. Drain and shake to rough the edges.
Heat {{ing:olive-oil}} in a roasting tin in the oven for 5 minutes.
Tip in the potatoes with {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:coriander-ground}}.
Roast 50 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Grate over the zest of {{ing:lemon}}. Season with salt.

recipes.name: Spiced Christmas roasties with ras el hanout
recipes.method_note: Crisp potatoes with a warm spice crust, roasted in duck fat.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Peel and chunk {{ing:potato-large}}.
Boil 8 minutes. Drain and shake well.
Heat {{ing:duck-fat}} in a tin in the oven for 5 minutes.
Toss the potatoes with {{ing:ras-el-hanout}}. Tip into the hot fat.
Roast 50 minutes, adding {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} for the last 10.
Finish with {{ing:salt}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Red cabbage, apple and pomegranate slaw
recipes.method_note: A crunchy, fresh counterpoint to all the richness.

steps.instruction: Shred {{ing:red-cabbage}} finely.
Cut {{ing:apple-medium}} into matchsticks.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}} and {{ing:lemon}} juice with salt.
Toss everything with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Hasselback potatoes with sage and garlic butter
recipes.method_note: Fanned, crisp edges and soft middles.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Lay each of {{ing:potato-medium}} between two chopsticks. Slice thinly down to the sticks.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:olive-oil}} and crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Brush over the potatoes. Roast 40 minutes.
Tuck {{ing:fresh-sage}} into the slits. Baste. Roast 20 minutes more.

recipes.name: Roast squash wedges with chilli butter and yoghurt
recipes.method_note: Sweet roast squash, cool yoghurt and spiced butter.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:butternut-squash}} into wedges, skin on.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt. Roast 40 minutes.
Mix {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} with grated {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.
Spread yoghurt on a platter. Top with squash, the chilli butter and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Sweet potato mash with lime and yoghurt
recipes.method_note: Bright and silky. A sharp edge stops it being too sweet.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Bake {{ing:sweet-potato}} whole for 50 minutes, until soft.
Scoop out the flesh. Mash with {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
Add the zest and juice of {{ing:lime}}. Season.
Top with {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.

swaps.text: Coconut yoghurt and olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Cauliflower cheese with Gruyère and mustard
recipes.method_note: Rich, golden and bubbling. Everyone's favourite side.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:cauliflower-head}} into florets.
Boil 5 minutes. Drain well. Lay in a dish.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} until thick.
Stir in {{ing:gruyere}}, half of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}, {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Pour over. Top with the rest of the cheese and {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling.

recipes.name: Roast fennel with orange and olives
recipes.method_note: Sweet, aniseed and salty. Lovely with fish or pork.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:fennel-bulb}} into wedges.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:fennel-seeds}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Roast 35 minutes, until soft and caramelised.
Add {{ing:olives-pitted}} and the orange segments. Roast 5 minutes.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

recipes.name: Carrot and swede mash with nutmeg butter
recipes.method_note: A Scottish favourite, bashed rather than blended.

steps.instruction: Peel and chunk {{ing:swede}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}.
Boil 25 minutes, until very tender.
Drain well. Leave to steam dry 2 minutes.
Mash roughly with {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:nutmeg}} and {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.

recipes.name: Maple and chilli pigs in blankets
recipes.method_note: Sticky, spicy, and gone in minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve each rasher of {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}. Wrap round {{ing:chipolatas}}.
Roast 25 minutes.
Mix {{ing:maple-syrup}} with {{ing:chilli-flakes}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves.
Brush over. Roast 8 minutes more, until sticky.

swaps.text: Gluten-free sausages, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Sausage, chestnut and cranberry stuffing balls
recipes.method_note: Make ahead and freeze. Bake from frozen for 35 minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 8 minutes. Cool.
Mix with {{ing:sausagemeat}}, chopped {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Add {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} and {{ing:egg-medium}}. Mix well.
Roll into 24 balls. Lay on a tray.
Bake 25 minutes, until golden and cooked through.

recipes.name: Sage, onion and apple stuffing
recipes.method_note: Crisp-topped and herby, with no egg needed.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-large}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 12 minutes.
Add grated {{ing:apple-medium}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Blitz {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} to crumbs. Mix in with chopped {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}.
Stir in {{ing:stock-vegetable}} until it holds together.
Press into a dish. Bake 30 minutes, until crisp.

swaps.text: Gluten-free bread

recipes.name: Roast beetroot with orange, dill and soured cream
recipes.method_note: Earthy, sweet and fresh. Brilliant with salmon or ham.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Wrap {{ing:beetroot-raw}} in foil with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Roast 60 minutes, until tender.
Peel and cut into wedges while warm.
Toss with the zest and juice of {{ing:orange}}.
Spoon over {{ing:soured-cream}}. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-dill}}.

recipes.name: Creamed spinach with nutmeg
recipes.method_note: The steakhouse side. Squeeze the spinach well.

steps.instruction: Wilt {{ing:spinach}} in a large pan for 2 minutes. Cool and squeeze dry.
Chop roughly.
Soften chopped {{ing:shallot}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 4 minutes.
Add {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}. Simmer 2 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and grated {{ing:parmesan}}. Season.

recipes.name: Balsamic roast shallots with thyme
recipes.method_note: Sweet, sticky, and very good with beef.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Cover {{ing:shallot}} with boiling water for 5 minutes. Peel.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Roast 40 minutes, turning once, until soft and glossy.

recipes.name: Glazed carrots with orange and star anise
recipes.method_note: Glossy and gently spiced. Done on the hob in one pan.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:carrot-medium}} into batons.
Put in a pan with {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:star-anise}}, the juice of {{ing:orange}} and a splash of water.
Cover. Simmer 10 minutes.
Uncover. Add {{ing:honey}}. Bubble 5 minutes, until glossy.

recipes.name: Tall Yorkshire puddings
recipes.method_note: Equal volumes of egg, flour and milk, and very hot fat.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:egg-large}}, {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:milk-whole}} and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Rest the batter 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 230C. Put a little of {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in each hole of a 12-hole tin.
Heat the tin in the oven 10 minutes, until the oil smokes.
Pour in the batter. Bake 20 minutes without opening the door.

swaps.text: Cooked in beef dripping, for the classic flavour (not vegetarian)

recipes.name: Pommes dauphinoise
recipes.method_note: Thin potatoes baked slowly in garlic cream.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Butter a dish with {{ing:butter-block}}.
Slice {{ing:potato-large}} very thinly.
Warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Layer the potatoes, seasoning each layer. Pour over the cream.
Bake 80 minutes, until tender and golden.

recipes.name: Crispy smashed potatoes with rosemary
recipes.method_note: Craggy and crunchy. Smash them flat for the most edges.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:potato-medium}} whole for 20 minutes. Drain.
Heat the oven to 220C. Oil a tray with half of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Squash each potato flat with a glass.
Drizzle with the rest of the oil. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Roast 35 minutes, until very crisp.

recipes.name: Green beans with almonds and brown butter
recipes.method_note: Quick, bright and crunchy.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:green-beans}} for 4 minutes. Drain.
Cook {{ing:butter-block}} with sliced {{ing:almonds}} for 3 minutes, until golden.
Toss with the beans and a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Peas with pancetta and little gem
recipes.method_note: A French way with peas: soft lettuce, salty pancetta.

steps.instruction: Fry {{ing:pancetta}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 4 minutes.
Add sliced {{ing:shallot}}. Cook 3 minutes.
Add {{ing:peas-frozen}}, shredded {{ing:cos-lettuce}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}.
Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Gochujang and honey roast sprouts
recipes.method_note: Sweet, spicy and charred. A modern twist.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Halve {{ing:brussels-sprouts}}.
Toss with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}. Roast 20 minutes.
Mix {{ing:gochujang}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}}.
Toss through the sprouts. Roast 5 minutes more.
Scatter with {{ing:sesame-seeds}} and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.

recipes.name: Cranberry, orange and port sauce
recipes.method_note: Make up to a week ahead. It thickens as it cools.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:cranberries}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:port}} and {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} in a pan.
Add the zest and juice of {{ing:orange}}.
Simmer 10 minutes, until most of the berries have burst.
Cool. Remove the cinnamon.

recipes.name: Red wine and onion gravy
recipes.method_note: A rich gravy with no meat juices needed.

steps.instruction: Cook sliced {{ing:onion-large}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} with {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} for 25 minutes, until dark.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Bubble 3 minutes.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Simmer 15 minutes.
Sieve, or leave the onions in.

swaps.text: Use a wine labelled vegan

recipes.name: Freekeh with pomegranate, herbs and pistachios
recipes.method_note: Smoky grains and lots of herbs. Good warm or cold.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:freekeh}} in {{ing:stock-vegetable}} for 20 minutes. Drain.
Dress with {{ing:olive-oil}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}} while warm.
Fold in {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, {{ing:pistachios}}, {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Dust with {{ing:sumac}}.

recipes.name: Roast celeriac wedges with dukkah
recipes.method_note: Nutty roots with a crunchy spice crust.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Peel {{ing:celeriac}}. Cut into wedges.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt. Roast 40 minutes.
Toss with {{ing:dukkah}}.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

recipes.name: Roast radicchio with orange and honey
recipes.method_note: Bitter leaves turn sweet and soft in the oven.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:radicchio}} into wedges.
Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Season.
Roast 15 minutes, until wilted and charred.
Whisk {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} and the juice of {{ing:orange}}. Spoon over.

recipes.name: Whipped feta with hot honey, pomegranate and pistachio
recipes.method_note: Creamy, salty, sweet and sharp. Serve with warm bread or crisp chicory leaves.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:feta}} and {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} until smooth and fluffy.
Add the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and a squeeze of juice. Blend once more.
Warm {{ing:honey}} with {{ing:chilli-flakes}} in a small pan for 1 minute.
Spread the feta in a wide swirl on a plate.
Spoon over the chilli honey and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Scatter with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}} leaves.

swaps.text: A vegan feta-style cheese and coconut yoghurt, with maple syrup for the honey

recipes.name: Gruyère gougères
recipes.method_note: Warm cheese puffs, light as air. They freeze well before baking.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a baking tray.
Bring {{ing:water}} and {{ing:butter-block}} to the boil in a pan.
Tip in {{ing:flour-plain}} all at once. Beat until it leaves the sides.
Cool 5 minutes. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}} one at a time until glossy.
Stir in most of the grated {{ing:gruyere}}, {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Pipe or spoon walnut-sized mounds onto the tray. Top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake 20 minutes, until puffed and deep golden. Serve warm.

swaps.text: Mature Cheddar or Comté

recipes.name: Devils on horseback with port-soaked prunes
recipes.method_note: A retro party bite, back in fashion. Soak the prunes the night before if you can.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:prunes}} in {{ing:port}} for at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut each rasher of {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}} in half. Stretch thin with the back of a knife.
Wrap each prune in a half rasher. Lay seam-side down on a tray.
Bake 12 minutes. Brush with {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Bake 3 minutes more.
Serve on cocktail sticks while hot.

swaps.text: Wrap in strips of smoked tofu brushed with oil, for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Crab crumpets with brown butter and chives
recipes.method_note: A posh rarebit. Brown the butter until it smells of hazelnuts.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a small pan on a medium heat.
Cook 3 minutes, swirling, until golden brown and nutty.
Mix {{ing:crab-white-meat}}, {{ing:mayonnaise}}, a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}.
Toast {{ing:crumpet}} until crisp. Brush with half the brown butter.
Pile the crab on top. Spoon over the rest of the butter.
Finish with snipped {{ing:chives}}.

swaps.text: Cooked prawns, chopped

recipes.name: Lobster and tarragon vol-au-vents
recipes.method_note: The 1970s party piece, made luxurious. Bake the cases on the day.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:puff-pastry}} into 12 rounds with a 6 cm cutter.
Press a 4 cm cutter halfway into each, to mark a lid.
Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Bake 15 minutes, until risen and golden.
Lift out the soft middles. Leave the cases to cool.
Boil {{ing:lobster-tail}} for 5 minutes. Cool, shell and dice.
Fold the lobster through {{ing:creme-fraiche}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-tarragon}} and lemon zest.
Spoon into the cases. Dust with {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}. Squeeze over a little {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Cooked prawns and crab
Thick mushroom sauce, for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Smoked haddock fish pie tartlets
recipes.method_note: All of fish pie in two bites. The filling can be made a day ahead.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a 12-hole tart tin with rounds of {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake 12 minutes, until pale golden.
Poach {{ing:haddock-smoked}} in {{ing:milk-whole}} for 5 minutes. Lift out and flake.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}, then the poaching milk, to a thick sauce.
Fold in the fish, {{ing:prawns-cooked}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Fill the cases. Pipe {{ing:mashed-potato}} on top. Grate over {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Bake 12 minutes, until the tops are golden.

swaps.text: More haddock

recipes.name: Baked feta with pomegranate, sumac and thyme honey
recipes.method_note: Out of the oven and onto the table. Scoop up with warm pitta.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Set {{ing:feta}} in a small dish. Pour over {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Tuck {{ing:fresh-thyme}} round it.
Bake 15 minutes, until soft and golden at the edges.
Drizzle with {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}}. Scatter with {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:sumac}}.

swaps.text: Halloumi, baked 10 minutes

recipes.name: Crisp kimchi pancakes with soy dipping sauce
recipes.method_note: Crisp edges, chewy middle. Choose a kimchi made without fish sauce for a vegan version.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:kimchi}}. Keep any juice.
Whisk {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:cornflour}}, {{ing:water}} and the kimchi juice into a batter.
Stir in the kimchi and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Heat half of {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan until shimmering.
Spread half the batter thinly. Fry 4 minutes a side, until crisp.
Repeat with the rest of the oil and batter.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:rice-vinegar}} and {{ing:sesame-oil}}. Cut the pancakes into wedges to dip.

swaps.text: Shredded white cabbage with 1 tsp gochujang

recipes.name: Cheddar and cumin cheese straws
recipes.method_note: Twisted, flaky and very moreish with a drink.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line two trays.
Unroll {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}.
Scatter half with grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}.
Fold the bare half over. Press down. Cut into 1 cm strips.
Twist each strip. Lay on the trays.
Bake 14 minutes, until crisp and golden.

swaps.text: Parmesan-style vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Scandi seafood platter with dill mayonnaise
recipes.method_note: A help-yourself board. Everything is cooked or cured already, so it is all assembly.

steps.instruction: Stir chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}} and the zest of one {{ing:lemon}} into {{ing:mayonnaise}}.
Slice {{ing:cucumber}} and {{ing:radish}} thinly.
Arrange {{ing:prawns-cooked}}, {{ing:smoked-salmon-cold}} and {{ing:crab-white-meat}} on a big board.
Add the cucumber, radishes, lemon wedges and the dill mayonnaise.
Slice and toast {{ing:sourdough}}. Serve alongside.

swaps.text: Rye crackers or gluten-free crispbread

recipes.name: Pickled squash, sage and cannellini toasts
recipes.method_note: Bright, crunchy and creamy at once. The squash pickles in 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:butternut-squash}}. Shave into thin ribbons with a peeler.
Warm {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} and a pinch of salt until dissolved.
Pour over the squash. Leave 30 minutes.
Mash drained {{ing:cannellini-beans-tinned}} with grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and half of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry {{ing:fresh-sage}} leaves in the rest of the oil for 1 minute, until crisp.
Toast slices of {{ing:sourdough}}. Spread with beans, top with squash and crisp sage.

swaps.text: Gluten-free bread

recipes.name: Shaved sprout, radicchio and caramelised walnut salad
recipes.method_note: Crunchy and bitter-sweet. Dress at the last minute so the leaves stay crisp.

steps.instruction: Toss {{ing:walnuts}} with {{ing:maple-syrup}} in a hot pan for 3 minutes. Cool on paper.
Shave {{ing:brussels-sprouts}} thinly.
Tear {{ing:radicchio}} into pieces.
Peel and slice {{ing:clementine}} into rounds.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} with salt.
Toss the leaves with the dressing. Top with clementine and walnuts.

recipes.name: Bright beetroot borscht with dill soured cream
recipes.method_note: Deep ruby and sweet-sour. A spoon of soured cream swirls through it.

steps.instruction: Peel and grate {{ing:beetroot-raw}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}.
Soften the onion in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 8 minutes.
Add the beetroot, carrot and shredded {{ing:cabbage-white}}.
Pour in {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 30 minutes, until tender.
Stir in {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}. Season.
Stir chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}} into {{ing:soured-cream}}. Spoon onto each bowl.

swaps.text: Oat-based crème fraîche, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Roast harissa carrots on labneh with dukkah
recipes.method_note: Sweet, smoky carrots on cool, tangy labneh.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Halve {{ing:carrot-medium}} lengthways.
Toss with {{ing:harissa-paste}}, {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:honey}} and salt.
Roast 30 minutes, turning once, until tender and charred at the edges.
Spread {{ing:labneh}} on a plate.
Lay the carrots on top. Scatter with {{ing:dukkah}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

swaps.text: Thick coconut yoghurt, and maple syrup for the honey, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Burrata with roast grapes, thyme and walnuts
recipes.method_note: Warm, jammy grapes burst over cold, creamy cheese.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss {{ing:grapes}} on their stems with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Roast 15 minutes, until blistered and starting to burst.
Splash with {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.
Tear {{ing:burrata}} onto a plate. Spoon over the warm grapes and their juice.
Scatter with toasted {{ing:walnuts}}. Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}.

recipes.name: Leeks vinaigrette with chopped egg and hazelnuts
recipes.method_note: A French bistro classic. Silky leeks, sharp dressing, crunchy nuts.

steps.instruction: Trim {{ing:leek}}. Simmer whole in salted water for 10 minutes, until tender.
Drain well. Halve lengthways.
Boil {{ing:egg-medium}} for 9 minutes. Cool, peel and chop.
Whisk {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Spoon the dressing over the warm leeks. Leave 10 minutes to soak in.
Top with egg, {{ing:capers}}, chopped {{ing:hazelnuts}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

recipes.name: Roast squash hummus with dukkah and chilli oil
recipes.method_note: Golden, sweet and nutty. Serve with flatbread or crunchy vegetables.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Peel and cube {{ing:butternut-squash}}.
Toss with half of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast 30 minutes, until soft.
Blend the squash, drained {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}, {{ing:tahini}}, {{ing:lemon}} juice and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Loosen with a little cold water until smooth.
Warm the rest of the oil with {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.
Swirl the hummus into a bowl. Spoon over the chilli oil and {{ing:dukkah}}.

recipes.name: Labneh with za'atar oil and crispy chickpeas
recipes.method_note: A cool, tangy dip with hot, crunchy chickpeas on top.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Drain and pat dry {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}.
Toss with half of {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:smoked-paprika}}. Roast 25 minutes, until crisp.
Spread {{ing:labneh}} in a shallow bowl.
Mix the rest of the oil with {{ing:zaatar}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Spoon over the labneh. Pile on the hot chickpeas.

swaps.text: Thick Greek yoghurt, or coconut yoghurt for a vegan version

recipes.name: Beetroot and gin cured salmon
recipes.method_note: Magenta-edged slices. Start two days ahead; the fridge does the work.

steps.instruction: Grate {{ing:beetroot-raw}}. Mix with {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:salt}}, {{ing:spirit-40}} and lemon zest.
Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} skin-side down on cling film. Pack the cure over it.
Wrap tightly. Chill 48 hours, turning once a day.
Scrape off the cure. Rinse and pat dry.
Press chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}} over the top. Slice thinly at an angle.
Serve with {{ing:horseradish-sauce}} and wedges of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out; the cure works without it

recipes.name: Smoked trout pâté with horseradish and pickled cucumber
recipes.method_note: Ten minutes to make, and it keeps three days.

steps.instruction: Bake {{ing:trout-fillet}} at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool and flake, skin removed.
Beat with {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:horseradish-sauce}} and the juice of half {{ing:lemon}}.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}}. Season with pepper.
Slice {{ing:cucumber}} very thinly.
Toss with {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and salt. Leave 15 minutes.
Serve the pâté with the pickled cucumber and toast.

swaps.text: Hot-smoked salmon or smoked mackerel, no cooking needed

recipes.name: Potted crab with mace and brown toast
recipes.method_note: An old English starter. Sealed under butter, it keeps three days.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}} gently with {{ing:mace}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}.
Mix two thirds of the butter into {{ing:crab-white-meat}} with the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Pack into four small pots. Pour the rest of the butter over to seal.
Chill 2 hours, until set.
Take out of the fridge 20 minutes before serving.
Serve with toasted {{ing:wholemeal-bread-slice}} and lemon wedges.

swaps.text: Gluten-free crackers

recipes.name: Chicory boats with pear, Stilton and candied pecans
recipes.method_note: A crunchy, finger-food starter. Bitter leaves, sweet fruit, salty cheese.

steps.instruction: Toast {{ing:pecans}} with {{ing:maple-syrup}} in a pan for 3 minutes. Cool and chop.
Separate {{ing:chicory}} into leaves.
Dice {{ing:pear}}. Toss with a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}.
Spoon pear and crumbled {{ing:stilton}} into each leaf.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:honey}}. Drizzle over. Top with pecans.

swaps.text: A vegetarian blue cheese: check the label for rennet

recipes.name: Caramelised onion and Gruyère tartlets
recipes.method_note: Slow onions are the secret. Make them the day before.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:onion-large}} thinly.
Cook slowly in {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:fresh-thyme}} for 40 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:puff-pastry}} into 6 squares. Score a border.
Spread onions inside the border. Top with grated {{ing:gruyere}}.
Brush edges with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Bake 18 minutes, until puffed.

recipes.name: French onion soup with Gruyère croûtes
recipes.method_note: Patience with the onions gives the deep, sweet flavour.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:onion-large}} thinly.
Cook in {{ing:butter-block}} on a low heat for 50 minutes, until deep brown.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Pour in {{ing:wine-white}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Simmer 20 minutes.
Toast slices of {{ing:sourdough}}. Top thickly with grated {{ing:gruyere}}.
Ladle soup into bowls. Float a croûte on each. Grill until bubbling.

swaps.text: Dark vegetable stock and a vegetarian Gruyère-style cheese

recipes.name: Scallops with 'nduja butter and lemon crumbs
recipes.method_note: Sweet scallops, spicy butter, crunchy crumbs.

steps.instruction: Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:nduja}}.
Toast {{ing:panko}} in a dry pan for 3 minutes. Stir in lemon zest and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Pat {{ing:scallops}} dry. Season.
Heat {{ing:olive-oil}} in a pan until very hot.
Sear scallops 90 seconds a side, until golden.
Add the 'nduja butter. Spoon over as it melts.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}. Scatter with the crumbs.

recipes.name: Clams with sherry, chorizo and parsley
recipes.method_note: A Spanish tapa. Throw away any clams that stay shut.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:clams}} well in cold water.
Fry diced {{ing:chorizo}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 3 minutes, until it releases its oil.
Add sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 1 minute.
Tip in the clams and {{ing:sherry}}. Cover.
Steam 4 minutes, shaking the pan, until the clams open.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve with {{ing:lemon}} and bread to mop.

recipes.name: Salt and Sichuan-style pepper squid with lime
recipes.method_note: Light and crisp. Fry in small batches so the oil stays hot.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:squid}} into rings. Pat very dry.
Mix {{ing:cornflour}}, {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}, {{ing:chilli-flakes}} and 1 tsp salt.
Toss the squid in the flour. Shake off the excess.
Heat 5 cm of vegetable oil in a deep pan to 180C.
Fry in batches for 90 seconds, until pale golden. Drain on paper.
steps.note: The oil in the list is the share the squid absorbs.

steps.instruction: Toss with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}. Serve with {{ing:lime}} wedges.

swaps.text: All cornflour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Gambas al ajillo: sizzling garlic prawns
recipes.method_note: Served still bubbling. Bread for the garlic oil is a must.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:olive-oil}} with sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}} on a low heat.
Cook 3 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold.
Turn the heat up. Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:smoked-paprika}}.
Cook 3 minutes, turning, until pink.
Splash in {{ing:sherry}}. Bubble 30 seconds.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve in the pan.

recipes.name: Prawn saganaki with tomato and feta
recipes.method_note: A Greek taverna dish, baked bubbling in one pan.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 6 minutes.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:dried-oregano}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Crumble over {{ing:feta}}.
Bake 10 minutes, until the prawns are pink.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-dill}}.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka skewers with mint chutney
recipes.method_note: Charred, spiced and smoky. Marinate for an hour or overnight.

steps.instruction: Cube {{ing:paneer}}.
Mix two thirds of {{ing:natural-yoghurt}} with {{ing:garam-masala}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}}, {{ing:chilli-powder}} and grated {{ing:ginger-fresh}}.
Coat the paneer. Leave 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers with chunks of {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:red-onion}}.
Grill on high for 10 minutes, turning, until charred.
Blend {{ing:fresh-mint}}, {{ing:fresh-coriander}}, the rest of the yoghurt and {{ing:lime}} juice to a chutney.

swaps.text: Firm tofu and coconut yoghurt, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Tandoori king prawns with lime and coriander
recipes.method_note: Quick to grill. The yoghurt keeps the prawns juicy.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:natural-yoghurt}}, {{ing:garam-masala}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}}, grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and the juice of one {{ing:lime}}.
Coat {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Leave 20 minutes.
Heat the grill to high. Thread prawns onto skewers.
Grill 2 minutes a side, until pink and charred.
Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Serve with the other lime in wedges.

recipes.name: Crab, mango and chilli lettuce cups
recipes.method_note: Fresh and zingy, a light start before a rich main.

steps.instruction: Dice {{ing:mango}}. Chop {{ing:chilli-fresh}} finely.
Mix with {{ing:crab-white-meat}}, the juice of {{ing:lime}} and {{ing:fish-sauce}}.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Separate {{ing:lettuce-iceberg}} into small cups.
Spoon in the crab. Top with crushed {{ing:peanuts}}.

recipes.name: Seared tuna tataki with yuzu ponzu
recipes.method_note: Seared outside, rare inside. Use the freshest tuna you can buy.

steps.instruction: Roll {{ing:tuna-steak}} in {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a pan until smoking.
Sear the tuna 30 seconds on each side. Chill 10 minutes.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:yuzu-juice}} and {{ing:mirin}}.
Slice the tuna thinly. Fan out on plates.
Spoon over the ponzu. Top with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:radish}}.

swaps.text: Tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Sesame prawn toasts
recipes.method_note: Takeaway favourite, much better made at home.

steps.instruction: Blitz {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}, {{ing:egg-white}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:spring-onion}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:cornflour}} to a paste.
Spread thickly over slices of {{ing:bread-slice-medium}}.
Press the paste side into {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Shallow-fry in {{ing:vegetable-oil}}, paste side down, 2 minutes. Turn, 1 minute.
Drain on paper. Cut into triangles.
Serve with {{ing:sweet-chilli-sauce}}.

recipes.name: Crisp duck filo cigars with plum sauce
recipes.method_note: Shredded spiced duck in crackling pastry.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Rub {{ing:duck-leg}} with {{ing:five-spice}} and salt.
Roast 2 hours, until falling apart. Cool and shred.
Simmer chopped {{ing:plums}} with {{ing:hoisin-sauce}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} for 15 minutes.
Mix the duck with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and 3 tbsp of the plum sauce.
Turn the oven to 200C. Halve each sheet of {{ing:filo-pastry}}. Brush with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Roll a line of duck in each, tucking in the ends.
Bake 15 minutes, until golden. Serve with the plum sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken liver crostini with sherry and sage
recipes.method_note: A Tuscan classic. Rich, rough-textured and deeply savoury.

steps.instruction: Trim {{ing:chicken-livers}}. Pat dry.
Soften chopped {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 5 minutes.
Add the livers. Fry 3 minutes, until browned but pink inside.
Add {{ing:sherry}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Chop roughly with {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:anchovy-fillet}}.
Spread on toasted slices of {{ing:sourdough}}.

recipes.name: Steak tartare with egg yolk and toasted sourdough
recipes.method_note: Bistro luxury. Buy the beef on the day from a butcher you trust.

steps.instruction: Chill {{ing:beef-fillet}} for 20 minutes, to firm it.
Chop the beef by hand into tiny dice.
Mix with finely chopped {{ing:shallot}}, {{ing:capers}}, {{ing:gherkins}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Season with {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:worcestershire-sauce}}, salt and pepper.
Shape into four rounds. Make a dip in each. Set in {{ing:egg-yolk}}.
Serve with toasted {{ing:sourdough}}.

swaps.text: A spoon of mayonnaise, for anyone pregnant or older

recipes.name: Pork tonnato with capers and rocket
recipes.method_note: An Italian classic, made with pork tenderloin. Cold, creamy and savoury.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub {{ing:pork-tenderloin}} with {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt.
Sear all over, then roast 18 minutes. Cool completely.
steps.note: 63C in the middle.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:tuna-tinned-in-spring-water}}, {{ing:mayonnaise}}, {{ing:anchovy-fillet}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Slice the pork thinly. Lay on a platter.
Spoon over the sauce. Scatter with {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:rocket}}.

recipes.name: Grilled figs with goats' cheese and prosciutto
recipes.method_note: Sweet, salty and creamy, done in minutes under the grill.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to high.
Cut a cross into the top of each of {{ing:figs-fresh}}.
Push a little {{ing:goats-cheese}} into each. Wrap in {{ing:prosciutto}}.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}} and thyme. Grill 5 minutes, until bubbling.
Serve on {{ing:rocket}}. Drizzle with {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.

recipes.name: Pear, prosciutto and pecorino salad with hazelnuts
recipes.method_note: A light, elegant plate that takes ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Toast {{ing:hazelnuts}} in a dry pan for 4 minutes. Chop roughly.
Slice {{ing:pear}} thinly.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:lemon}} juice and {{ing:honey}}.
Toss {{ing:rocket}} and pear with half the dressing.
Drape {{ing:prosciutto}} over. Shave over {{ing:pecorino}}.
Scatter with hazelnuts. Drizzle with the rest of the dressing.

recipes.name: Pheasant and pistachio terrine
recipes.method_note: Make two days ahead; it slices better and tastes deeper.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C. Line a 1 kg loaf tin with {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}, ends overhanging.
Cut the breast and leg meat off {{ing:pheasant}}. Dice it.
Mix {{ing:pork-mince}}, the pheasant, {{ing:pistachios}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}} and {{ing:spirit-40}}.
Add crushed {{ing:juniper-berries}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves, {{ing:allspice}} and 1 tsp salt.
Pack into the tin. Fold the bacon over. Cover with foil.
Bake in a tray of hot water for 90 minutes.
steps.note: 70C in the middle.

steps.instruction: Weigh down with tins. Chill overnight.
