swaps.text: Chicken thighs

recipes.name: Roast Jerusalem artichoke, hazelnut and watercress salad
recipes.method_note: Nutty, earthy and crisp, finished with a sharp lemon dressing.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Scrub {{ing:jerusalem-artichoke}} and halve.
Toss with half of {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Roast 35 minutes.
Add {{ing:hazelnuts}} to the tray for the last 5 minutes.
Whisk the rest of the oil with {{ing:lemon}} juice and {{ing:honey}}.
Toss with {{ing:watercress}} and the warm artichokes.
Shave over {{ing:parmesan}}.

swaps.text: A vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Celeriac and apple soup with hazelnut oil
recipes.method_note: Silky, gently sweet, with a crunchy topping.

steps.instruction: Peel and dice {{ing:celeriac}}, {{ing:apple-medium}} and {{ing:onion-medium}}.
Soften in half of {{ing:olive-oil}} for 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Simmer 25 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Stir in {{ing:oat-cream}}.
Chop toasted {{ing:hazelnuts}}. Mix with the rest of the oil.
Spoon over each bowl.

recipes.name: Roast cauliflower soup with curry leaves and coconut
recipes.method_note: Gently spiced and golden. The sizzled curry leaves make it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Break {{ing:cauliflower-head}} into florets.
Toss with 1 tbsp of {{ing:vegetable-oil}}. Roast 25 minutes.
Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:turmeric-ground}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add the cauliflower, {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 10 minutes. Blend.
Sizzle {{ing:mustard-seeds}} and {{ing:curry-leaves}} in the last of the oil. Spoon over.

recipes.name: Chestnut, sage and white bean soup
recipes.method_note: Velvety and warming. Vacuum-packed chestnuts make it quick.

steps.instruction: Soften chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:celery-stick}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in 1 tbsp {{ing:olive-oil}} for 10 minutes.
Add most of {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} and drained {{ing:cannellini-beans-tinned}}.
Pour in {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Season.
Fry {{ing:fresh-sage}} leaves and the rest of the chestnuts, crumbled, in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes.
Spoon onto each bowl.

recipes.name: Mushrooms on toast with sherry cream and tarragon
recipes.method_note: A warming, savoury plate. Let the mushrooms brown before stirring.

steps.instruction: Tear {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} into pieces.
Fry in {{ing:butter-block}} on a high heat for 6 minutes, until golden.
Add sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 1 minute.
Pour in {{ing:sherry}}. Bubble 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-tarragon}}. Season.
Spoon over thick toasted slices of {{ing:sourdough}}.

swaps.text: Oat cream and olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Crispy hoisin mushroom lettuce cups
recipes.method_note: All the pleasure of crispy duck pancakes, with shredded mushrooms.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Shred {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} with two forks.
Toss with {{ing:vegetable-oil}} and {{ing:five-spice}}. Roast 25 minutes, until crisp.
Toss with half of {{ing:hoisin-sauce}}.
Cut {{ing:cucumber}} and {{ing:spring-onion}} into thin matchsticks.
Separate {{ing:lettuce-iceberg}} into cups.
Fill with mushrooms, cucumber and onion. Add the rest of the hoisin and {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

recipes.name: Beetroot carpaccio with horseradish cream and walnuts
recipes.method_note: Paper-thin and jewel-like. Mix golden and red beetroot if you can.

steps.instruction: Slice cooked {{ing:beetroot}} as thinly as you can.
Overlap the slices on four plates.
Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}. Season.
Mix {{ing:creme-fraiche}} with {{ing:horseradish-sauce}}.
Dot over the beetroot. Scatter with {{ing:walnuts}}, {{ing:watercress}} and snipped {{ing:chives}}.

swaps.text: Oat-based crème fraîche, with a vegan horseradish, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Roast figs with Stilton, walnuts and thyme honey
recipes.method_note: Warm figs, melting blue cheese. Lovely with a glass of port.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut a deep cross into each of {{ing:figs-fresh}}. Open them out.
Push in crumbled {{ing:stilton}}.
Warm {{ing:honey}} with {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves. Spoon over.
Roast 10 minutes, until soft and bubbling.
Serve on {{ing:rocket}} with chopped {{ing:walnuts}}.

recipes.name: Whipped ricotta with roast grapes and rosemary
recipes.method_note: Light, creamy and very pretty. Serve with crisp toasts.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Toss {{ing:grapes}} with 1 tbsp {{ing:olive-oil}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-rosemary}}. Roast 15 minutes.
Beat {{ing:ricotta}} with lemon zest and the rest of the oil until fluffy.
Spread on a plate.
Spoon over the warm grapes. Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}.
Scatter with chopped {{ing:pistachios}}. Squeeze over a little {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Crisp halloumi with pomegranate, za'atar and mint
recipes.method_note: Squeaky, salty and hot from the pan, with sweet-sharp toppings.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:halloumi}} into 8 pieces. Pat dry.
Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 2 minutes a side, until golden.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}} in the pan. Turn to coat.
Lay on a plate. Scatter with {{ing:zaatar}}, {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.

recipes.name: Red onion tarte tatin with goats' cheese
recipes.method_note: Sticky, glossy onions under crisp pastry, turned out to serve.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Halve {{ing:red-onion}} through the root.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} in a 24 cm ovenproof pan.
Add {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and the onions, cut side down. Cook 10 minutes.
Lay {{ing:puff-pastry}} over the top. Tuck in the edges.
Bake 25 minutes, until puffed and deep golden.
Rest 5 minutes. Turn out onto a board.
Crumble over {{ing:goats-cheese}}. Top with {{ing:rocket}}.

recipes.name: Creamy leek and Gruyère vol-au-vents
recipes.method_note: Buttery leeks in crisp cases. Bake the cases the same day.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:puff-pastry}} into 12 rounds. Mark a smaller lid in each.
Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Bake 15 minutes. Lift out the middles.
Soften sliced {{ing:leek}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 10 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}}, grated {{ing:gruyere}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Fill the cases. Top with snipped {{ing:chives}}.

recipes.name: Shaved sprout Caesar with crisp crumbs
recipes.method_note: Crunchy, punchy and a brilliant use of sprouts.

steps.instruction: Shave {{ing:brussels-sprouts}} thinly.
Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}}, lemon juice, grated {{ing:garlic-clove}}, chopped {{ing:capers}} and half of {{ing:parmesan}}.
Toast {{ing:panko}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} for 3 minutes, until golden.
Toss the sprouts in the dressing.
Top with crumbs and the rest of the cheese. Add lemon zest from {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: A vegetarian hard cheese
Two anchovies, for the classic version (not vegetarian)

recipes.name: Sweet potato falafel with lemon tahini
recipes.method_note: Baked, not fried. Soft inside, crisp outside.

steps.instruction: Microwave {{ing:sweet-potato}} for 8 minutes, until soft. Scoop out the flesh.
Mash with drained {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}}, {{ing:coriander-ground}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Shape into 16 balls.
Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the balls with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Bake 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Whisk {{ing:tahini}} with {{ing:lemon}} juice and water to a pouring sauce.

swaps.text: Gram flour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Spiced red lentil soup with lemon and crispy onions
recipes.method_note: A Turkish-style soup: gentle, golden and very comforting.

steps.instruction: Slice one {{ing:onion-medium}} thinly. Fry in 2 tbsp {{ing:olive-oil}} for 12 minutes, until crisp.
Soften the other onion, chopped, and {{ing:carrot-medium}} in the rest of the oil for 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:cumin-ground}}, half of {{ing:chilli-flakes}} and {{ing:tomato-purée}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add {{ing:lentils-red-dry}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Add {{ing:lemon}} juice.
Top with the crispy onions and the rest of the chilli.

recipes.name: Avocado, pink grapefruit and crab salad
recipes.method_note: Fresh, bright and creamy, with no cooking at all.

steps.instruction: Cut the peel off {{ing:grapefruit}}. Slice out the segments over a bowl.
Slice {{ing:avocado}}.
Mix {{ing:crab-white-meat}} with the zest of {{ing:lime}} and chopped {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.
Whisk 2 tbsp grapefruit juice with {{ing:olive-oil}} and lime juice.
Arrange {{ing:watercress}}, grapefruit and avocado. Pile on the crab.
Drizzle with the dressing. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Grilled oysters with garlic, Parmesan and parsley crumbs
recipes.method_note: For anyone unsure about raw oysters: warm, savoury and golden.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to high. Open {{ing:oysters}}. Keep them in the deeper shell.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Mix {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} with grated {{ing:parmesan}}.
Put a little garlic butter on each oyster. Top with crumbs.
Grill 4 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Serve with {{ing:lemon}} wedges.

recipes.name: Mussels with cider, leeks and crème fraîche
recipes.method_note: A West Country take on moules. Mop up the juice with bread.

steps.instruction: Soften sliced {{ing:leek}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:butter-block}} for 6 minutes.
Pour in {{ing:cider-dry}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Cover. Heat 4 minutes, shaking the pan.
Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Serve in warm bowls with the juices.

recipes.name: Smoked mackerel pâté with quick pickled red onion
recipes.method_note: Smoky, creamy and sharp. Five minutes to make.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:red-onion}} thinly.
Toss with {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and salt. Leave 20 minutes.
Flake {{ing:smoked-mackerel}}, skin removed.
Blend with {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:creme-fraiche}}, {{ing:horseradish-sauce}} and lemon juice.
Spoon into a dish. Top with the onion and {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Serve with toast and {{ing:lemon}} wedges.

recipes.name: Salmon rillettes with dill and capers
recipes.method_note: Two salmons, fresh and smoked, folded with butter. Rich and spreadable.

steps.instruction: Poach {{ing:salmon-fillet}} in simmering water for 8 minutes. Cool and flake.
Chop {{ing:smoked-salmon-cold}} finely.
Beat soft {{ing:butter-unsalted}} with {{ing:creme-fraiche}} until smooth.
Fold in both salmons, {{ing:capers}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-dill}} and lemon zest.
Season. Pack into a dish. Chill 1 hour.
Serve with toast and {{ing:lemon}} wedges.

recipes.name: Cod brandade with garlic toasts
recipes.method_note: A Provençal dip of cod, potato and garlic olive oil.

steps.instruction: Salt {{ing:cod-fillet}} lightly. Leave 30 minutes. Rinse.
Poach in {{ing:milk-whole}} for 8 minutes. Flake.
Boil peeled {{ing:potato-medium}} for 15 minutes. Drain.
Warm {{ing:olive-oil}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Beat the cod and potato, adding the garlic oil and a little poaching milk.
Add {{ing:lemon}} juice and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve warm with toasted {{ing:sourdough}}.

recipes.name: Salmon tartare with yuzu, avocado and sesame
recipes.method_note: Bright and clean. Buy sushi-grade salmon and keep everything cold.

steps.instruction: Dice {{ing:salmon-fillet}} finely. Keep chilled.
Mix {{ing:yuzu-juice}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:sesame-oil}}.
Dice {{ing:avocado}}. Slice {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Fold the salmon, avocado and onion through the dressing.
Press into rings on four plates. Top with {{ing:sesame-seeds}} and {{ing:chives}}.

swaps.text: Tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Roast squash with burrata, crisp sage and hazelnuts
recipes.method_note: Sweet, creamy and crunchy, with brown butter over the top.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:butternut-squash}} into thin wedges.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}. Roast 30 minutes.
Fry {{ing:fresh-sage}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 2 minutes, until crisp and the butter browns.
Lay the squash on a platter. Tear over {{ing:burrata}}.
Spoon over the sage butter. Scatter {{ing:hazelnuts}}. Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}.
